publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Product quality decision-making is an essential part of enterprise strategic decision-making. By the approach of differential game theory, this paper puts forward a quality decision-making model with two competing enterprises under dynamic environment. The research shows that, key factors of quality decision-making include attenuation coefficient of quality credit, basic manufacturing costs, demand-price elasticity coefficient, demand-quality credit elasticity coefficient and discount coefficient. Consequently, these factors play important roles on making developing strategies for enterprises.

articleTitle: Prediction based on Markov chains for ladderlike rural labor transfer in Western China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In order to analysis and predict rural labor transfer quantitatively, a homogeneous Markov chain model of discrete parameters is proposed in this paper to describe the 三 situation of ladderlike labor transfer in western china. We consider the labor as the transfer variables and five terrain shifts the labor as variable states to build the model after carefully describe the situation of transfer. First order condition is considered to estimate transition probability matrix and estimate the parameters through Least Square method. After that, with the application of stationary distribution theory, we predict the situation of labor transfer in short term and long term. We conclude by numerical experiment that the transfer of labor in countryside is not sufficient and the current process of urbanization should be accelerated. The urban and rural dualization cannot be eliminated in current economic and policy attraction level. These quantitative results are acknowledged as essential to stimulate the local government making the situation clear and doing further work to promote the transfer.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Cost of capital and investment efficiency
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Model of pension fund scheme and its application
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the implementation of pension investment program. It is divided into two stages, namely, deposit and withdrawing money. According to the relationship between the actual changes of total deposits and quantity, the model of pension fund scheme based on the difference equation is established, and then the model is solved by iteration algorithm. Based on the model, the insured persons in four different ages groups which are 20 to 29, 30 to 39, 40 to 49, and 50 to 59 are analyzed respectively, then the total deposit in the account and the corresponding monthly pension of insured person when they are in 60 years old are obtained. The results of this paper provide decision-making reference for pension fund investment in real life.

articleTitle: The authority structure of agri-food supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Agri-food supply chain is a hybrid organization. Hybrids can rely neither on command nor on prices for overcoming difficulties, authority emerge to govern complex relationships. We simplified that supply chain have only two part, producer and distributer. There are more and more coordination and collaboration in agri-food supply chain. The allocation of authority in supply chain can induce agents make investment that generates the optimum of supply chain. The investment is specific investment. Allocation of authority depends on whose investment is important and specificity of investment. The criteria of importance can be safety of food or guarantee of supply. Complementary of investment play an important role in allocation of authority.

articleTitle: A fast algorithm for computing Chebyshev-Fourier moments
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the invariant orthogonal moments, Chebyshev-Fourier moments (CHFMs), and the computation of CHFMs are introduced. With the specific symmetrical or anti-symmetrical properties of the Chebyshev-Fourier (CHF) basis functions, a fast algorithm for computing the CHFMs is given. Both theoretical analysis and experimental testing show that the fast algorithm makes the time for computing the CHFMs shorter than the direct method.

articleTitle: New kind model for university human resource development: The research on formation and construction of academic innovation team
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Talent resource is the first resources of university human resources. Academic innovation team construction, as a new kind of human resource development mode, adapt to the requirements of knowledge innovation and development of talent resource. This paper put forward a layered model for formation academic innovation team, the model was used to analyze the existing construction practice of academic innovation team from China. Three principles on academic innovation team construction proposed to universities.

articleTitle: Strategy oriented performance management system for Independent College teacher
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Balanced Scorecard (BSC) has been widely applied in a number of companies and non-profit organization. This paper analyzes the feasibility of the BSC for Independent College, and builds a new performance management system based BSC for independent college teacher. The new system sets strategy as the fundamental point, according to the four-dimensional balance, creates two cards: Subject BSC and Teacher BSC. In addition, the paper also analyzes all aspects of the implementation process of the new system, as well as what should be pay attention to in the implementation process.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research about cooperation and innovation based on patent public
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A Resource-Based perspective of entry mode choices of Electronic Components industry into China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The aim of this study is to empirically investigate the effectiveness of the Resource-Based Theory in explaining the entry mode choices of Taiwanese Electronic Components firms in China markets during the time period from 2003 to 2005. The annual data includes as many as 267, 324, and 283 firms respectively. This study explores how the firms' resources (defined as firms' assets and capabilities) influence the entry mode choices between wholly-owned subsidiaries (WOS) and joint ventures (JV) of Taiwanese Electronic Components firms. It also identifies those factors that have an important impact on the choices of entry mode and provides meaningful suggestions for the new firms that wish to invest in the China market.

articleTitle: The application of UML in the development of CRM sale system online
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Information technology and network technology is developing rapidly, the relationship between firms and customers are becoming increasingly important. According to the management characteristics of CRM, the paper applies modeling methods and tools of UML to analyze and design sale management system online. This paper builds system development models, including the use case diagrams, the class diagrams, the activity diagrams and the timing diagrams, and develops the system for a sale company. It proves that UML can be used in sale system online designing and make the progress more easy and effective.

articleTitle: The earnings management study under the separation of the control rights and the cash-flow rights
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper focuses on the effect of the degree of separation between the control rights and the cash-flow rights has on the earnings management of Chinese listed companies. Our analysis and empirical data show that under the effective control of shareholders, as the degree of the separation increases, the more sever the earnings management behavior and the lower level of disclosure in the earnings information. The controlling stockholders who possess the specific information can exercise their control out of self-interests through the use of Stock Pyramids and Cross-ownership ties to increase the opacity of the company and to gain extra profits for themselves.

articleTitle: Research on the issues and countermeasures existing in the process of implementing stockholder's rights drive in listed companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Stockholder's rights drive means allowing managers to take part in the surplus distribution for the purpose of building a kind of drive and restrictive mechanism using property connection as the tie, lowering the company's cost in entrusted agency and improving company value, finally solving the short-termism of senior management team caused by less driving power. However, for the implementation of stockholder's rights drive in our country, there still exist many drawbacks. Therefore, against those problems existing in listed companies, this paper has made special research and proposed appropriate measures to improve it.

articleTitle: The real option analysis method of venture investment evaluation in the Industrialization of high-new technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Every stage in Industrialization process of high-new technology has high venture and huge capital input, venture investment is the special requirement of the high-new technology industry's high risk character. The real option approach is put forward to evaluate venture investment in the industrialization of high-new technology, and an example is given in order to demonstrate the objectiveness and effectiveness of real option method to the NPV improved model.

articleTitle: Selection of the reverse logistics mode of the waste appliances based on ANP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In order to make an efficient choice of reverse logistics operating mode of household appliance manufacturers, this paper first analyzed the factors affecting people to select the reverse logistics mode of waste appliances. Then it used the ANP to set up the evaluation mode of reverse logistics. Finally, it applied the model to a company-using Super Decisions to apply the evaluation model, obtaining the reverse logistics operating mode suitable for the company to handle waste appliances. The result indicates that ANP can efficiently solve the problem of choice of reverse logistics recycling mode, making the decision more scientific and rational.

articleTitle: Research on the behavior of webpage redirection in subject collections
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Based on the science of consumer behavior, and with the help of the research on information searching, in this paper, the behavior of webpage redirection in subject collections is researched. By experimental method, the factors affecting the webpage redirection are generalized, and the behavioral model of webpage redirection is built, finally the enlightenment to the market management is discussed. The research reveals the behavior rules of the network users in searching information and provides scientific guidance for enterprise for developing online marketing.

articleTitle: The degree distribution and degree correlations of the network with both preferential and random attachments
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the degree distribution and the two vertex degree correlations of the network with both preferential and random attachments are studied. Based on the concepts and techniques of Markov chain theory, a rigorous proof for the existence of the steady-state degree distribution is provided, and the exact analytic formula of the degree distribution and the scaling exponent are mathematically derived. By using the rate equation approach, we obtain an asymptotic expression for two vertex degree correlations.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research of personnel executives occupational mobility
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Analyzing the feasibility of using the management principles integrate the Chinese traditional Five-Elements Chromatology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Through a long development history, the Chinese traditional Five-Elements Chromatology had been gradually formed. It is both equal to the Modern Chromatology, and also it is lacked the modern scientific methods to manage. Based on sustainable development concept, this paper not only analyzes the feasibility of introducing the Management principles to the Chinese traditional Five-Elements Chromatology, also elaborates to use the methods of the Management to manage the tradition Five-Elements Chromatology. After analyzing and researching, proof is feasible of utilization the Management methods to manage the Chinese tradition Five-Elements Chromatology.

articleTitle: The integrated model of management accounting tools based on integrated innovation theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The research on the integration of management accounting tools mainly focuses on the framework and the mode of the integration but lacks the study of theoretical foundation, basic ideas. Based on the core ideology of integrated innovation theory, this paper puts forward basic ideas of the integration of management accounting tools which includes the motivation, the key point, the essence, the foundation and the framework. From the aspects of business environment, integration platform, strategy integration, knowledge integration, technology integration, and organization integration, the integrated model of management accounting tools is constructed.

articleTitle: Research of cross-platform intersystem integration technology based on SOA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Praised as of future generation technology architecture of integration, SOA (Service-Oriented Architecture) can be used to resolve the difficult problem in exchanging of information system. Foreign software providers' products of SOA are not applicable to domestic enterprises in development from the aspects of ease and cost performance. Using the latest open-source architecture, the paper analyzes the design of system based on SOA and proposes a solution of exchanging data between two systems under different platforms. In the application, the authors summarize a tip of using the data type of object Array to express complex data and offer the flexible solution for system application integration.

articleTitle: Based on factor analysis of BP neural network China logistics operation performance of listed companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Based on factor analysis, 21 of listed logistics companies, obtained from the numerous variables in the factors, calculated to score every enterprise comprehensive, integrated and based on their score on the operating results of sort and evaluate. With BP neural network with generalization model, the conclusion. Based on factor analysis and neural network model can evaluate performance of listed companies the logistics industry.

articleTitle: An empirical study on the crowding in-out effects of FDI on domestic investment in Jiangxi Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Select the data of GDP, domestic real investment in fixed assets and the actually utilized foreign direct investment from 1984 to 2009 in Jiangxi Province. Based on the framework of VAR model, the article uses cointegration test, impulse response function and vector error correction model to analyze FDI's effect on total domestic investment in Jiangxi Province. By empirical analysis, it shows: in the long-run equilibrium state, FDI crowds in domestic investment, and in the short-run, FDI crowds out domestic investment. According to the conclusions of empirical research, the main purposes of this paper are to analysis the problems in using FDI and to give the suggestions about how to take advantage of FDI and reduce its negative impact.

articleTitle: Discussion on the improvement of China's corporate financial reports
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Presently, there are some problems exists in China's financial report, such as single-goal, inadequate information disclosure and seriously lag-behind accounting information. Under the principles of meeting cost-effectiveness and effective disclosure, the financial reporting reform should take the reform of the objectives of financial accounting, recognition and measurement methods, enriching the disclosure content and the establishment of real-time reporting system as goals.

articleTitle: Research on model base system of GDSS based on SOA in heterogeneous environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the difficult problem that it's hard to share models of group decision support system (GDSS) in heterogeneous environment, the paper constructs internal structure and applicable external scenario for model base system of GDSS using service-oriented architecture (SOA), which is an integration technology architecture. The authors design an access mode of model base system based on “service scenario” in order to improve the use efficiency of models and realize model services publication and call in distributed model base systems of GDSS in heterogeneous environment. As for development for GDSS, the paper may be used as a reference.

articleTitle: Study on the coordinated development of East Asian bond credit rating
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Since outbreak of the U.S. subprime crisis in August 2007, the crisis caused losses in U.S. and around the world are not to be ignored in either U.S. real economy or volatility of Global financial market. The crisis has undoubtedly brought a lot of inspiration to East Asian Economies. Because Bond markets in most East Asian Economies are still at the initial stage, the credit rating systems are very imperfect. The paper analyzes firstly the necessity of the coordinated development of East Asian bond credit rating, then dissect status and problems of Bond Ratings cooperation between East Asian Economies, and finally puts forward strategic proposals about the coordinated development of East Asian bond credit rating.

articleTitle: Text-mining-based funding monitoring for science foundation: A case study of NSFC
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: A text-mining based approach of funding monitoring for science foundation was proposed, by identifying demands in the management of science foundation. Through computer visualizing algorithms and technologies of text mining, the valuable pattern was automatically found from numerous data related with funding facts, and represented as knowledge map, in purpose of supporting decision making of managers and experts. The general funding monitoring process and key technology were mainly illustrated, and then an empirical study about the International Academic Meeting in China (IAMC) of NSFC was demonstrated to verify its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Molecular dynamics study of the structural character of α-syn12 peptide bound to Synphilin-1 protein
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Synphilin-1 is a novel α-synuclein interacting protein presenting in the Lewy bodies, the N-terminal 12 residues peptide of α-synuclein (α-syn12) can binding to the coiled-coil domain of Synphilin-1. However, the complex structure in water has not been determined by experimental methods, so that the possible structure of this complex and interaction sites have been studied by docking algorithms and molecular dynamics simulations (MD). We constructed the potential of mean force from the distributions of the backbone (ϕ, ψ) angles for the residues 2–11 of α-syn12 peptide and the free energy surface (FES) of the α-syn12 peptide based on two principle components (PC1 and PC2). The corresponding representative structure corresponds to the β hairpin structure with Turn9-6 and four hydrogen bonds (HB<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4–11</inf>, HB<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6–9</inf>, HB<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9-6</inf> and HB<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11-4</inf>). These results were consistent with conformation clusters.

articleTitle: Research on the influence mechanism of community value on customer loyalty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In the real and virtual environment, there are two types of consumer communities, namely service community and product community. Based on Social Identity Theory and the empirical study, this paper explored the similarities and differences in the influence mechanism of community value and customer loyalty between these two communities. This paper dimensioned community value by functional value (FV) and service value (SV), and then introduced community identity as the mediating variable to clearly explain the relationship of community value and customer loyalty. Through the field study on a fitness club and an online product community, we received 224 questionnaires and examed the hypotheses model by LISREL 8.7. The results indicate community value is the driving factor of customer loyalty, community identity fully mediates the relationship of SV and customer loyalty in product community and of FV and customer loyalty in the service community. In the end, managerial suggestions and future research are provided.

articleTitle: Partner selection in supply chain based on rough set and fuzzy set
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Along with the rapid development of science and technology, the traditional enterprise management mode has shown that it can rapidly respond promptly to the weak market. Supply chain management is an important part of the value chain of the supplier selection and evaluation of the supply chain management is an important content. This paper using rough sets theory and fuzzy theory, the selection of supplier evaluation is analyzed. Through the analysis of the results, the enterprise may, according to each specific situations of supply chain partner, to choose a different partners, in order to better promote supplier and cooperation between partners.

articleTitle: Joint inventory-advertising control with constraints
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: We study the optimal control problem for a periodic review inventory system. Advertising partially control the random demand. The ordering and advertising decisions are constrained. There are two cases: The fixed capacity constraint and the dynamic cash flow constraint. We build the dynamic programming models and present the structure of the optimal control policies. Our optimization problems combine operations, marketing and financing issues.

articleTitle: Simulation and optimization of LOPT workshop production logistics based on Flexsim
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Based on the fact of a Line output transformer workshop,aimed at the questions such as the roundabout logistics, the unreasonable layout of the production sectors and the low utilization of some processes,etc,this paper applied the process analysis and simulation technology of Flexsim to do some analysis and optimization. The major work is as follows: First of all, the process of production logistics system in the workshop was analyzed and a system model was set up; Secondly, all the collected raw data was analyzed by statistical method, then the bottlenecks were found out by modeling and simulation with Flexsim; Thirdly, the process and layout of the workshop was analyzed and optimized by the process analysis method. Then the better production logistics system was provided. Finally, the new system was analyzed and evaluated synthetically. It was evident that using simulation methods to optimize the production logistics system can enhance many objects of the system. The methods of this research have a practical reference and guide to the design and improvement of manufacturing production logistics system.

articleTitle: The evaluation of resettlement result in water project based on GIS and AHP — To take Changshu area of Zou matang project as an example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Resettlement in water project is a complex and systematic project with multi- level, multi - objective and multi-property characteristics. The evaluation of resettlement result has become the focus of related research. This paper combines the GIS tools and AHP to evaluation of resettlement result in water project. The main steps are: First, the alternative resettlement area in water project will be selected in a variety of constraints by the aid of GIS tools, GIS spatial query method, in order to alleviate the preparatory works; Secondly, weights of evaluation indexes will be determined using AHP; Third, the evaluation effect will be mapped by use of the statistical features of GIS mapping. Finally, take the Zou matang Project Area in Changshu as an example, the evaluation method has been verified by the actual survey data, and the test results shows that this method has the characteristics of simple, intuitive and strongly operational and can be widely extended to other kinds of resettlement evaluation.

articleTitle: Constructing College English Web Teaching Platform by internet technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of internet technology, advanced educational technology philosophy and its teaching methods go deep into all areas of English as foreign language teaching in China. How to make full use of college English teaching with the aid of advanced net technology is currently a hot issue in the reform of College English Teaching and thus become a primary research subject. This paper proves the necessity and significance of constructing College English Web Teaching Platform Based on B/S Mode in light of its features and it explores the functions of the network platform and how to develop it.

articleTitle: Power saving route algorithm on underground Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The routing protocol which can meet the requirement of underground wireless sensor network had a decisive role on the monitoring quality and the survival time of network. By combining the beacon nodes chain deployment of tunnel Wireless Sensor Networks, the Minimum Energy Relay Routing (DMERR) algorithm which is based on dynamic path loss parameter is proposed, this algorithm can save the energy of communication by obtain the exact path loss parameter of each place in roadways and calculation the optimum communication distance accurately. The simulation results show that this routing algorithm can meet the requirements of the underground linear wireless sensor networks and reduce the routing energy consumption effectively.

Author Keywords: dynamic minimum energy relay routing algorithm

articleTitle: AVSAG: An augmented video service in the Access Grid
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The Access Grid (AG), targeting advanced collaboration environment over high-performance networks, provides group-to-group interactions across the grid. However, current AG still employs VIC (Video Conferencing Tool) to offer only pure video, while most AG users expect to collaboratively refer and manipulate the 3D geometric models of grid services' results in live videos of AG session. Augmented Reality (AR) provides an approach to solve the deficiencies due to its characteristics of combining virtual and real, real-time interaction and 3D registration. This paper applies AR to AG and investigates a new type of augmented video service in AG (AVSAG). The AVSAG merges the 3D geometric models of grid services' results and real video scene of AG into one scene, and allows distributed AG users to interactively and collaboratively participate in the AR environment with better experience. Similar to the existed video service in AG, the AVSAG is also divided into two kinds: augmented video producer service and augmented video consumer service. The capabilities of AVSAG are verified by demonstrating an AG prototype with such service and the results prove that it yields superior quality compared to the traditional pure video service of AG.

articleTitle: Comparing the optimization functions and methods of community detection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Detecting and characterizing the community structure of complex network is fundamental. There are many algorithms, were sorted to three types of criterion: mathematical method,mechanism of community structure and optimization method. In this paper, we discuss the optimization methods of community detection, compare and analyse the objective functions and solution methods. Based on this, we develop a new optimization function, named community quantification which is accurate for many types of networks.

articleTitle: Research of HLA time management against deadlock contains lookahead
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: To further solve the problem of deadlock in time management mechanism, an improved algorithm of GALT which synthetically considered the factor of lookahead was given. It overcomes the deficiency that the previous algorithm will lead RTI to lose lookahead when federate uses NMR (Next Message Request) to advance. The improved algorithm was discussed. Analysis results show that the improved algorithm not only can solve the problem of deadlock, but also can consider the effect of lookahead in every time-advance mode sufficiently even lookahead is modifying dynamically.

articleTitle: Reserch of how to control network virus in large local area network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In order to create a safe and stable environment for the students to use computers, to avoid virus, I analyzed the network in campus and planned reasonably, set specifically from switches to computers, then effectively control the virus in the spread of large-scale complex networks.

articleTitle: The analysis of industry energy consumption and carbon emissions of Tianjin
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With the convened of Copenhagen conference, the national is vigorously respond to the low-carbon economic development. In such a situation, Tianjin is also actively engaged in. As an important aspect of the development of Tianjin, energy, also need to make reforms. As the foundation of the national economy, Energy is playing a very important role in ensuring the sustained, rapid and healthy development of the national economy and improving people's lives. How to develop low carbon energy, and reduce carbon emissions, is an important part of constructing the low-carbon economy society. This passage is mainly analyzes the relationship between the industrial structure and the carbon emissions, which is base on the unit of GDP of the scale-above industry in Tianjin and carbon emissions.

articleTitle: Study on application of value engineering in improvement of production operation in oilfield?
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper established the value analysis method of oil production operation based on function and cost analysis. The alternative programs were developed and implemented from the aspects of obtaining data, transmitting data, operating facilities, monitoring facilities and maintaining facilities. During the implementation, adopting digital technique and automatic control mode replaced the artificial operation in the original production mode. With the changes of function and cost, the value of production operation of the oilfield has been enhanced and good economic benefits has been achieved.

articleTitle: Research on consistency checking method of UML model in embedded system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: To solve the problem of consistency checking of UML model in embedded system, the model consistency was analyzed. The executable UML was put forward which was an enhanced subset of UML. The state-event table was used to express the system model from model's transformation. And the model's consistency checking was come true by dynamic emulation. Finally, a case was presented to verify the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Analysis of E-commerce system security evaluation model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The evaluation of EC security often copies the standard of information security, the effect of evaluation is rough and partial. This paper firstly constructs the security frame of EC system, which includes five layers based on TCP/IP protocol and introduces the security technologies in each layer; and then designs the security evaluation model of EC system bases on the analytic hierarchy process(AHP), which includes the evaluation layer(A), four main factors(B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> to B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>) and 12 sub-factors(C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> to C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>). Thirdly this paper establishes the assessment matrixes of A-B and B-C and check their consistency to get the assessment matrixes of A-C. In addition, this paper calculates the total evaluation coefficient of three EC systems and the best one was choosed. At last, the conclusion is that the model of EC security can get the satisfied result of evaluation using AHP.

articleTitle: The K-nearest neighbor fast searching algorithm of scattered data
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The paper has put forward an improved K-nearest searching algorithm of scattered data, which is significant to the technology of surface recreate of reverse engineering. Firstly, the initial segmentation of point cloud space is made by adopting the traditional block algorithm, and then estimates the average dot pitch of point cloud. Re-divide the point cloud space according to average dot pitch. The block result decreases the searching range of k-nearest neighbor searching algorithm.

articleTitle: A flexible and secure image compression coding algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the problem of efficient image data encryption and compression. Based on feedforward-feedback nonlinear dynamic filter (FFNDF) and employing random arithmetic coding, a novel image encryption scheme integrated with the set partitioning in hierarchical trees (SPIHT) has been proposed. The FFNDF is employed to generate pseudorandom sequences which determine the mapping the interval position in the process of arithmetic coding. By encoding the bits obtained from different passes in the SPIHT algorithm with adaptive random arithmetic coding, we obtain a flexible secure image compression coding scheme. Also, the scheme accommodates features of progressive coding of the SPIHT. Theoretical analysis and experimental results show that the scheme has good cryptographic security and perceptual security, and it does not affect the compression efficiency apparently. The efficiency and security of the encryption scheme makes it an ideal choice in various applications such as total encryption, selective encryption, conditional access.

articleTitle: P2P-based application-layer multicast tree active update mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Currently most of the high-bandwidth internet applications use both P2P technology and application-layer multicast technology. Considering the loose coupling between the P2P technology and application-layer multicast technology in the existing applications, this paper proposes a new active update mechanism of P2P-based application-layer multicast tree from the view of the network architecture. This active update mechanism makes full use of the fault-tolerance and detection capabilities of P2P technology, sends feedback information of underlying network actively, and triggers the strategic management module of application-layer multicast. These studies demonstrate that such active update mechanism can enhance the efficiency of the update of application-layer multicast tree and decrease the number of reconstruction of multicast tree to guarantee its stability by using redundant state information and alternative capacity of P2P technology.

articleTitle: A dynamic evaluation model base on expected object for comprehensive trust of supplier—STEM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Supplier is critical for enterprise. In order to solve the problems related to trust of suppliers, we, in this paper, propose a dynamic evaluation model base on expected object for comprehensive trust of supplier called STEM. Base on the expected object of enterprise, the concept of trust vector was introduced into STEM. Many kinds of factor that affect supplier's trust and trust management that is used in network security were taken to this model. After that, a dynamic method was provided to evaluate comprehensive trust of supplier. Finally, the results of simulation experiment indicate that this model is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Orthogonal iterative learning least squares for neural identification of nonlinear time-varying systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: By utilizing QR decomposition technique, an orthogonal iterative learning least squares algorithm is proposed for time-varying high-order neural network training, which is applied for the identification of time-varying nonlinear systems over a finite time interval. With the help of two-dimensional Givens transformation, both on-line and off-line identification procedures are presented for weights update in an iterative manner. Numerical results are given which verify that time-varying weights converges as iteration number increasing, and the neural network output can follow the practical output data.

articleTitle: Fuzzy evaluation of pontoon bridge regiment's fighting efficiency based on matter element analysis model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: It's a complex task to evaluate the fighting efficiency of Pontoon Bridge Regiment, because it is difficult to set up a reasonable, accurate and scientific evaluation system and to quantify the qualitative indexes of different natures. The AHP method was used in the evaluating system, and consisting of more than 20 categories of indexes, such as indexes of command and decision-making capabilities, indexes of rapid-reaction capability, indexes of pontoon crossing site engineering capacities, indexes of field survival, and indexes of comprehensive support capacity, were established. A matter element model of the grade evaluation to assess the fighting efficiency of Pontoon Bridge Regiment was built up by combining quantitative analysis with qualitative analysis, with quantitative analysis on the former. The quantitative number values to express evaluation result were given by calculating relational degree. The multi-ingredient fighting efficiency assessment was transformed into the single-object decision and the evaluation values can directly show the integrative level of the fighting efficiency of Pontoon Bridge Regiment. The application result shows that it is simple and practical.

articleTitle: The agility of enterprise production plan and its promotion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In order to meet the customers' demand on time and make quick response to the unpredictable market demand, the flexibility of enterprises' production plan has been an important method of improving response ability and operation efficiency. This paper mainly analysis the phenomenon of changeable production plan which lacks agility. Based on clearing the agility of production plan and the content of agile production planning, analyzing the reasons for change in plans, this paper puts forward some ways to enhance the agility of the production plan, including shorting the duration, program objects and the scope, cutting down planning time by Parallel work and using agile programming methods based on rolling plan method.

articleTitle: Study on the relationship between fixed assets investment and business income of the telecommunication enterprises based on distributed lag model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With the change of the environment and the subject of telecommunication market investment, and the current large-scale construction of 3G networks, the relationship between investment and income became the most concerned problem of the telecommunication enterprises. This paper first conducted a cointegrating test on investment in fixed assets and the business income in telecommunication industry, then quantized the relationship between the two using the dynamic distributed lag model, and analyzed the results integrated with the features of telecommunication enterprises. Finally came up with the application proposal of the model in the telecommunication enterprises.

articleTitle: The research and simulation on capture technology in synchronous serial of frequency hopping communication system based on Simulink
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Synchronous frequency hopping communication system is one of the core technologies. In accordance with the synchronization requirements for high speed frequency hopping communication, we combine prefix combined with the self-synchronization method of information delivery, combine with dual-frequency pattern method to realize the PN sequence phase search controller design and complete serial acquisition, so that frequency hopping system will reach synchronization. By Simulink simulation software it makes verification on designs.

articleTitle: On the corporate financial risk early warning and control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Financial risk that a firm will be unable to meet its financial obligations. This risk is primarily a function of the relative amount of debt that the firm uses to finance its assets. A higher proportion of debt increases the likelihood that at some point the firm will be unable to make the required interest and principal payments. Early warning and controlling financial risks effectively can provide a safe and steady operating environment. This paper believe that through analyzing the financial situation, preparing the cash-flow budget, establishing the financial risk index system and computational model to warn early the financial risk. On the other hand, through establishing effective capital structure, selecting correct fund-raising methods and keep the assets highly liquid to control the financial risk effectively.

articleTitle: Decentralized PID controllers of steam-turbine generator set based on probabilistic robust method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Based on probabilistic robust and multi-objective optimization algorithm, a method of controller parameters optimization is proposed to meet the requirements of power plants with uncertainties. The general frame of multi-objective genetic algorithm NSGA-II is used, combined with Monte-Carlo experiment evaluation, to solve the probabilistic robust optimization problem. The method has good feasibility, without any limitations on the style of process and controller. The decentralized PID controllers of steam-turbine generator set are optimized using this method. The simulation results show that the proposed method has better probabilistic robustness, compared with those based on nominal model optimization, thus has good feasibility in robust controller optimization.

articleTitle: Research on behavioral risk of participants in construction project based on the theory of stakeholders
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The behavioral risk of participants in construction project means the possibility of loss to the project because of participants' behaviors. Currently risk management has been commonly applied across the construction sector; however it very rarely includes the effects of behavioral factors. But often behavior of participants is major reason for project risks. Meanwhile, a project's success or failure is strongly influenced by how well it meets stakeholders' expectations and their perceptions of its value. The paper analysis how construction practitioners perceive risk management and in particular behavioral risks factors from project stakeholders perspectives. It also identifies and appraises behavioral risks so as to develop more effective risk reduction measures.

articleTitle: Early-warning model of grain price based on Support Vector Machine in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The research work in this paper follow four steps: define warning situation, seek warning sources, analyze warning omens, foretell warning degree. First, we define the grain price fluctuation rate as situation indictor and its warning line in a systematic way. Second, we analyze the factors that influence grain price and divide them into eight categories. Third, basing on above result, we select 23 indictors as warning omens. Meanwhile, a new method is attempted to be used in this paper and the grain price early-warning problem is transformed into machine learning problem by introducing SVM method which is gaining popularity in machine learning field at present in the world.

articleTitle: Research on E-commerce security education experimental platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With the prosperity of E-commerce industry, the electronic commerce course construction also needs developing synchronously. E-commerce security is the important part of e-commerce, and is also a course which combines theory with practice closely. To improve the practical operative ability, a perfect teaching experiment platform is necessary for students to do the e-commerce security-related experiments. In this work, according to the characteristics of e-commerce, we design the corresponding application-oriented teaching experiment and realize a completely controllable experimental platform, which can help students comprehend the course contents and master the practical skills.

articleTitle: The investigation of image compress coding based on wavelet transformation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: For wavelet-based image compression algorithm, it focuses on the hierarchical trees algorithm (SPIHT) and makes description of the principle and process of the algorithm. Apply MATLAB to convert the gray image by wavelet transformation, then conduct coding on wavelet transform image coefficients SPIHT. The received bit stream obtained by decoding and inverse wavelet transform the reconstructed image simulation. The results have been reconstructed image signal to noise ratio and the operation time. Experimental results show that the algorithm can quickly and efficiently encode the image processing.

articleTitle: Research on knowledge diffusion within R&D team based on the knowledge gap
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Based on the previous research foundation, this paper first defines “knowledge gap”. Then, it analyzes seven context factors of knowledge gap, including knowledge foundation and cultural background, knowledge attributes, willingness to participate, absorptive capacity, tools and platforms, trust,team culture,and how they influence intra-team knowledge diffusion. Accordingly, establishes influence mechanism model of knowledge diffusion within R&D team. Finally, the paper puts forward relevant suggestions.

articleTitle: Chinese express industry concentration degree measure and analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: “Postal Law” and its supporting laws “express business license management measures” are implemented in granted in October 2009, that gives the Express Industry with great vibration. It will promote the express industry reorganization, optimize the industry structure. This paper uses the absolute concentration degree method, surveys the Chinese express industry concentration degree. And according to the calculation, we analyze the impact of market concentration factor from the economies of scale, entry barriers, product differentiation and the policies and regulations. Finally, we propose two ways to improve delivery of the proposed industrial concentration.

articleTitle: Multi-population Binary Ant Colony Algorithm for the Horizontal Manufacturing Collaborative Alliance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Horizontal Manufacturing Collaborative Alliance (HMCA) is to minimize the comprehensive cost and balance the production loads among the selected manufacturing enterprises. An algorithm named Multi-population Binary Ant Colony Algorithm with Hybrid Behaviors (MPBAHB) is designed. On the basis of Binary Ant Colony Algorithm (BACA), two strategies of zoning and environmental evaluation/reward were introduced to compensate for the difficulty of getting multiple solutions at the same time. Moreover, a searching behavior named “central disturbing” was introduced to BACA, so as to strengthen the searching ability. The experimental prove that the algorithm can get better solutions while keeping the distribution of Pareto front.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of RFSM packing technology for PE files
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper used an analysis tool at the base of understanding the portable executable file format. It presented the whole processes of the encrypting on the PE file in detail. It focused on the principle and process of packing or unpacking. The random-fusion-self-modifying-packing technology emerged. This technology uses the SDK fuse procedure. And the key procedure code on the packing lane. It making the key code in the packing can not run after unpacking. While unpacked, It self modifying code. And the procedure can not be normal operation. This paper included the technology's principle, algorithm and implementation. The software experimental results show that the method can balance in safety and performance.

articleTitle: Development of the tender evaluation system based on department performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The key of tender system is assessment of solutions. The assessment is organized and implemented usually by the tender department and the tender performance forms its integral performance. Tender evaluation system is based on this feature in its functions and data processes. It's developed in MS SQL server and PB environment and run on the LAN. It supports multi-stage selecting experts and export of performance reports.

articleTitle: An interactive multimedia web-based learning system for Pro/Engineer training
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, web-based learning systems (WBLS) become more popular for self-learning and long-distance learning. According to the drawbacks of the existing WBLS for Pro/Engineer course, a new framework approach is presented for design and development of an interactive multimedia web-based learning system (IMWBLS) for Pro/Engineer training. It develops an effective and customized web-based learning system for Pro/Engineer basic design course by using popular software tools. The proposed IMWBLS presents rich contents of the course. It uses MS agent technology and Captivate software to realize speech function and interactive video function. With the adaptive learning guidance, it adapts the presentation of Pro/Engineer educational material according to students' weaknesses. IMWBLS not only realizes personalized teaching but also increases the students' attention and promotes the interaction between teaching and learning.

articleTitle: Environmental education: A new perspective on sustainable development of ecotourism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: As an inherent constituent of ecotourism, environmental education is of great significance to the sustainable development of ecotourism. However, existing studies pay little attention on environmental education and the improvement of people's environmental awareness. Based on relevant literatures, this paper aims to construct an environmental education model for ecotourism. It engaged in the analytical research on such aspects as the rationale of the environmental education model, its objects and target system, its product development, the evaluation of its effectiveness and the guarantee mechanism for its implementation. Finally, this paper concludes that the exploration on the environmental education model is an important area in the study of the sustainable development of ecotourism.

articleTitle: Political relationship and the efficiency of credit resource allocation: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper examines the impacts of informal and formal institutions on the efficiency of credit resource allocation in the emerging market from the perspective of political connections and marketization. Based on the data of non-state owned listed companies in China, we find that as an informal institution, Political relationship helps companies to obtain more long-term loans. However, from a social perspective, such a credit resource allocation is inefficient because the companies obtaining loans via relationship are more likely to overinvest. Nevertheless, marketization, as a formal institution, helps weakening the impact of relationship on credit resource allocation, improving the efficiency of resource usage.

articleTitle: Electronic paper book: Strengths, problems, opportunities and challenges
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Electronic paper book (EPB) is a brand new concept and product different from traditional electronic readers. In the recent two years, from technology to product, EPB has been developed rapidly, creating a prosperous market. EPB means a great milestone-like revolution for both the information content industry and high tech manufacturing industry. EPB undoubtedly has many strengths Compared with traditional media. There are also many opportunities for EPB industry. But problems and challenges are unavoidable. After a brief introduction to EPB, strengths of it are introduced first. Problems of EPB are mainly discussed then. Opportunities and challenges are analyzed next (SPOC). Finally some countermeasures are proposed for development of EPB.

articleTitle: Demand forecast of human resource based on set pair analysis theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The set pair analysis theory is used to demand forecasting for human resource. Considering the certainties and uncertainties in the dynamic environment of human resource, the paper adopts the identity-discrepant-contrary (IDC) pattern to execute the classification and measurement, the weight coefficient is determined by entropy theory. Then the prediction is given to a certain group, the results show that the method is effective for the prediction of human resource, it has provided a new idea in this area.

articleTitle: The quality-control mechanism of dairy supply chain for Double Moral Hazard —Based on Internal Punishment model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we presented an Internal Punishment Coordination model for Double Moral Hazard. After the demonstration, we also completed the Numerical Simulation and Fairness Analysis with the cases of Effect of Additional Compensation, Effect of incoming inspection and outing detection and Effect of the accuracy of the Independent Investigation System. The coordination model can incentive the Manufacturer and the Milk Depot to improve their quality, and better the final Dairy products ultimately. The additional compensation for the consumer and the probability of incoming inspection and outing detection have significant influence on the quality of the Milk Depot and Manufacturer with the exception of the Accuracy of the independent investigation System, also, The fairness criterion is always broken at all times when the punishment is based on the incoming inspection. But it can drive the fairness criterion to be more easily achieved when the additional compensation for the consumer varies and other parameters is fixed.

articleTitle: Manufacturing feasibility evaluation of RFID chips embedded in artificial organs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Advances in medical technology rely heavily on the collection and analysis of measured data to facilitate patient diagnosis and business decisions. The healthcare industry, particularly pharmaceuticals and diagnostic processes, has an ongoing need to improve item tracking and data collection to improve the quality of care while reducing cost. This paper primarily focuses on integrating Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) inside of artificial organs to provide doctors and nurses a better synopsis of the embedded organ. The remote, non-invasive characteristics of RFID can facilitate the information needs of healthcare without imposing additional burden onto the patient or staff. Properly deployed RFID enabled devices is envisioned to provide convenient and accurate data for artificial organs conditions, and critical information that may be necessary for medical specialist to better serve patients with these organs. This paper describes an all-encompassing RFID tracking system that begins with compliance documentation from implementation duration of the patient's life. This RFID system can provide data for decision-making and facilitate compliance with FDA imposed e-pedigree requirements. This transcript introduces healthcare trends in order to motivate the need for a biocompatible RFID system. The overall goal of the pending research is to develop biocompatible RFID tag components for use with systems implemented inside artificial organs and continued through the duration of the device as mentioned above. It is envisioned that successful implementation of this technology could improve life expectancy of patients with artificial organs by ten percent.

articleTitle: The optimal decision rules discovery
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the data set expressed by decision-list, proposed an algorithm of optimum decision rules discovery based on granule computing. It increased the efficiency of decision rules mining by two ways, improving speed of getting frequent item sets with granule computing and deleting invalid candidate sets. Finally the result of calculating test showed the algorithm is validity.

articleTitle: Constructing web plat for universities faculty human resources training
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Faculties are the core human resources(HR) to universities, and training faculties can realize HR maintenance and add value to them. This paper explores the theory foundation of training in higher education, concerning competency theory, lifelong learning theory, and competency-based theory. It emphasizes the necessity and significance of constructing web plat for faculty training. Its function is designed as four parts developed by Web 2.0 with features of being personalized and open to all, which are information service, the resources sharing, interaction and management innovation.

articleTitle: Simulation and optimization research of blood center inventory management under dynamic demand
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: A simulation model was set up correspondingly with the operational characteristics of blood center inventory system. Under an emergent blood-collecting event, the concept of “equivalent daily demand” within lead time was presented, and the solution of emergent reorder point was derived. By running the simulation model, recommendations were made for the inventory management of Jiangsu province blood center based on the historical data of 2005-2008. Fill rate was enhanced up to 99% after optimization. At the meanwhile, expired volume and times of emergencies were sharply cut down, which proves the validity and feasibility of our simulation model. It is also effective for the management of other inventory systems with deteriorating items.

articleTitle: Theoretical research and empirical analysis on strategic management innovation of small and medium condiment enterprises about improving marketing capability
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In recent years, with the improvement of living standard, people pay more attention to the diversification of nutrition and flavor in diet, which creates a broad market space for development of condiment industry. At present, there aren't many real bigger and stronger enterprises for the condiment industry, small and medium-sized enterprises are in the majority. The deficiencies in China's small and medium condiment enterprise innovation are backward concept of marketing, serious consubstantial trend, etc. Based on the background of marketing and related environmental conditions of small and medium condiment enterprises in present china, by taking Qishan County JinXiang Food Co. Ltd as the research object, this paper points out marketing situations and existing problems of small and medium condiment enterprises by detailed investigation and empirical analysis, and presents corresponding solution schemes and strategic management innovation assumptions small and medium condiment enterprises about improving marketing capability on this basis.

articleTitle: Contracts to motivate R&D investment in supply chain under double moral hazard condition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we model a manufacturer that contracts with one designer. When the designer's R&D investment and manufacturer' R&D investment both are unobservable information, the manufacturer and designer may incur moral hazard after contracting. The manufacturer designs the revenue sharing contract in order to reduce the double moral hazard. We find that the fraction of supply chain revenue the designer keeps only depended on his degree of important in outcome. By reasonable distributed supply chain revenue the contract can coordinate the supply chain system. However, the manufacturer must give more fraction of revenue to designer than its contribution and the system's first-best R&D cannot be achieved.

articleTitle: Study on the coal mine safety assessment based on rough set - neural network - evidence theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The safe reliability assessment of coal mine safety system is a multifactor overall merit problem. In this paper, we firstly introduced the principle and method of coal mine safety assessment based on rough set - neural network - evidence theory. Secondly, we used rough set method to carry out the pretreatment of information. Thirdly, according to the information structure after treatment, we formed the information processing system of rough set - neural network - evidence theory. Finally, we carried out the analysis of fusion result. In conclusion, we applied rough set, neural network, D-S evidence theory to the processing of safe mass monitoring data, which can reduce the uncertainty in the process of data processing. It provides us an effective basis and method to know the security situation and the development trend, and to analyze the cause and the harm of the coal mine accident.

articleTitle: Study on improvement of information entropy weight multiple objectives decision method and its application in safety evaluation of highway traffic
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The safety evaluation management of highway traffic project is generally a complex problem which is affected by many factors. Safety evaluation indexes, methods and steps are very worth studying. Aiming at this problem, this paper selects three typical suburban roads to establish the evaluation indexes of road traffic safety, and evaluates their safety levels by an improved entropy weight multiple objectives decision making method presented in this paper, and gives some practical suggestion of how to improve according to the evaluation results. Compared with other references, Presents method can comprehensively consider objective information provided by the practical system and subjective judgment of experts. These can offer the reference for multiple objectives safety evaluation management of highway traffic project.

articleTitle: The research about coordinated development of logistics industry and economy in Hebei province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper describes the relationship between logistics and economy of 1990-2008 years in Hebei, and explains the relationship by empirical analysis, and puts forward relevant suggestions about the logistics industry with the economy joint development. Not only has logistics industry played fundamental role in regional economic, but also constraints the regional economic operation speed and efficiency. This paper put forward suggestions through the construction of regression model and elastic model, such as the logistics of Heibei needing of Co-ordination plan, promotion to modern logistics supply capacity, development of regional economy, etc.

articleTitle: Research on strategies of technical barrier to trade after financial crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Many economists regard the financial crisis from the “bottom” to the recovery stage, known as “post-crisis period.” Due to uncertain situation, control the situation seems complicated and confusing, making it difficult to grasp the implementation of monetary policy. However, technical barriers to trade faced by our country's exports as the largest non-trade barriers have seriously affected China's economy. Obviously, strengthen the attention and research to technical barriers to trade, and take active measures to defense it, will have great significance to promote China's economic.

articleTitle: Research on effect factors and mechanism of Chinese family business governance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: After 30 years of rapid growth, Chinese family businesses (CFBs) have become a critical force in boosting the national economic performance and structural adjustment. The property rights system innovation emerged as the core and bottleneck of the CFBs governance when they first implemented asset accumulation and encountered governance dilemma. We analyzed the contingent factors in determining the governance pattern as well as the unbalanced nature of the CFBs development, on the base of which proposed a contingent sequential flow analysis model so as to describe the dynamic process of CFBs governance model selection and transition, and set a foundation for further theoretical research.

articleTitle: Ownership structure and investment efficiency
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper used all china a-share non-financial listed companies in 2001–2006 as initial samples, to analyze how the two dimensions of the ownership structure affect over investment of companies. This paper finds that the following conclusions: (1) There is a positive correlation between the share ratio of largest shareholder and overinvestment level. (2) The second largest shareholder plays a role in restraining overinvestment impulse. But overall, the ownership balance curbing overinvestment is not good; on the contrary it has increased the level of investment. The evidence provides a new idea to improve the governance of ownership structure and to securities regulators.

articleTitle: Study of Influencing Factor Index System of tourism development for Henan based on AHP method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: An analytical way to reach the best decision is more preferable in many business platforms. In this study, Analytic Hierarchy Process has been applied for evaluating the impact factors of foreign exchange income by tourism market in Henan province. Moreover, the score methodology by specialists and MATLAB software are also used for getting the impact factors' weight scores. The results show that the top four among the evaluated impact factors are Signtseeing, Long-distance, Arrivals and Accommodation, which are the key factors influencing foreign exchange income by tourism market of Henan province.

articleTitle: A Web-based advertising content analysis platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With the booming of online economy, more and more advertisements appear on the network, meanwhile many illegal advertisements emerge. To detect the advertisements automatically, a Web-based advertising content analysis platform is proposed in this paper. This platform consists of the following three parts: web information extraction, advertiser's named entity identification and advertiser's industry identification. The experiments show the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Research on FAST TCP congestion control algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Introduces briefly the TCP congestion control techniques and analyzes the characteristic of FAST TCP. The ns simulator is used to evaluate the performance of FAST TCP algorithm. Then concludes advantage and disadvantage of FAST TCP.

articleTitle: Vulnerability mechanism and evaluation of human-land system of mining cities in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Chinese mining cities have come across a lot of economic problems because of resource exhaustion in recent years, this change has also brought about a series of social problems and environmental problems. This paper reviews the development process of mining cities of china, analyses the vulnerability characteristics of human-land system of mining cities, and put forward vulnerability mechanism of human-land system of mining cities, which include the following: the fundamental cause of vulnerability of human-land system of mining cities, the process of vulnerability of three subsystems, which contain economic system, social system and natural system. In addition, we illustrate an example of evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on the countermeasures to accelerate development of circular economy of small towns in Tianjin-driving mechanism construction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With the acceleration of urbanization in our country, small town construction is facing various kinds of difficulties and problems, and the importance of developing the circular economy of small towns is increasingly significant. Although the construction of demonstrative small towns in Tianjin has been in the front ranks in the country, the speed and scale of the development of circular economy are still behind steps of small town construction. Thus, in the new historical period to accelerate the construction of circular economy of small towns in Tianjin is extremely urgent. In accordance with the requirement of the Scientific outlook on development, in the light of principle of sustainable development, on the basis of the idea of green economy and low-carbon economy, the model of construction of small town circular economy in Tianjin should be speedily probed, the evaluation indicator system of small town circular economy in Tianjin should be speedily established, the driving mechanism of small town circular economy in Tianjin should be speedily constructed. The driving mechanism includes construction of leading mechanism, organizing mechanism, motivating mechanism and monitoring controlling mechanism. The above mechanisms interrelate each other, supplement each other, promote each other, consisting an organic integration.

articleTitle: Information ecosystems following triple play
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Triple Play is an inexorable trend, It is the integration of telecom, internet and TV networks-will enable us to do access all three services through a single device. It will bring great changes for the organizations in both business ecosystems. In the paper we not only find the boundaries of Broadcasting Ecosystem and Telecommunications ecosystem but also find the boundaries of the new ecosystem that we call Information Ecosystem from the academic point. At the same time we analyze that witch are most likely to become the leader of this ecosystem, and give some advices to the enterprises who adopt keystone.

articleTitle: Data mining based reduction on credit evaluation index of bank personal customer
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Making a credit evaluation to bank personal customer is an essential way to eliminate the risk for banks. But most credit evaluation index systems of bank customers in most researches are over complicated and difficult to apply. The paper attempts to accomplish reduction analysis on credit evaluation index system of bank customer based on data mining method, including cluster method and decision tree method.
