In this paper, a common credit evaluation index system of bank customer is constructed. Moreover, the rationality of the index system is analyzed by clustering method, and according to which, the index system is reduced to 8 indexes from 18 indexes. Furthermore, the efficiency of the reduced index system is verified by decision tree method. The reduced credit evaluation index system is more efficient with the analysis cost declined.

articleTitle: Strategic study on reverse logistics development based on e-commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Reverse logistics can improve customer loyalty, increase service investment and enhance consumer confidence in products. By studying the reverse logistics in e-commerce, and then proposed a new returned reverse logistics model which adopts the optimal return price strategy to establish and high-efficient management information system of reverse logistics. It takes the advantage of the concept of supply chain management for the purpose of improving the management level and service quality to perfect product quality so as to reduce the return goods which are transported into reverse logistics. In addition, this paper holds that customer loyalty can be enhanced with the help of reverse logistics to build up customer' confidence in products the commercial enterprises have supplied. However, this paper focuses that only by establishing high-efficient management information system of reverse logistics and adopting the optimal return price strategy can the enterprises get an advantage in market competition and new space of profit.

articleTitle: Study on eliminating the quality defects of vulcanized products with large size rubber-belt vulcanizing machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With ANSYS software hot plate thermal fields are analyzed and based on the MATLAB software, the functional relationship between hot plate temperature and the length is plotted, and then the fitting curve is given; the vulcanization intensity of belt is calculated, and the three-dimensional model figure of vulcanization intensity over time is drawn; the vulcanization effect of belt is calculated, the hot plate curing effect and the length of the curve is drawn to address the tape when the quality of intermittent curing deficiencies, the hot plate the equivalent scope was summarized.

articleTitle: A three-dimensional hybrid modeling method of single building
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In view of losing spatial relations in CSG modeling method, an improved method called Voxel Growing CSG Modeling was proposed. And aiming at the limitation of single modeling method, a hybrid modeling method that based on CSG and B-rep was proposed. Then, the modeling procedure was given. The geometric model information of single building was ensured to be full and rich.

articleTitle: Analysis of FDI Technology spillover effects—the enlightenment for underdeveloped areas to promote independent innovation system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This article tries to find an effective way for underdeveloped areas to Achieve sustainable development. It reviewed an extensive literature and found that the creativity of FDI Technology is limited, the fundamental way for underdeveloped areas to make a leap forward in its development is Promoting regional independent innovation system construction. This paper Stressed that this should be an important function of government, and the fiscal policy is a positive and direct incentives. Finally, the paper pointed out the objectives of fiscal policy adjustment in the process of promoting independent innovation system construction in underdeveloped areas.

articleTitle: The study on crisis public relations strategies of enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzed the interests and conflicts of business and media, and then carried out strategies from four aspects: enterprise attitude, information dissemination, media collaboration and internal staff. That is AIMS strategy of public relations, hoping to be an effective guide for enterprise's crisis management.

articleTitle: Official selection model based on multi-attribute group decision making
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The problem of official selection is analyzed and researched. The problem of official selection is converted to a problem of multi-attribute group decision making. Based on the fuzzy math theory and decision making method, a fuzzy multi-attribute decision making model is presented to solve the problem of official selection. Then a decision making example is given to demonstrate the feasibility and rationality of this new model. Therefore, a novel and effective way is obtained to solve the problem of official selection under the uncertain information.

articleTitle: Risk evaluation and risk prevention countermeasure of developing missile weapons
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a systematized method of risk evaluation based on the independent third party is presented to deal with the risk evaluation problem in developing missile weapon. Firstly, the risk factors in developing missile weapon are identified and analyzed. It concluded that the technology risk, performance risk, cost risk, schedule risk and management risk are five main risk factors in developing missile weapon. Secondly, an index system of risk evaluation is proposed based on these five risk factors, and a risk assessment model based on AHP is presented to choose the optimal developer. Finally, for the problem of how to avoid and reduce risks in the steps of demonstrating, schemes, production, researching and service, several risk prevention countermeasures are given from the perspective of the independent third party.

articleTitle: Analysis and research on noise inside cab of truck
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Based on the ANSYS software platforms, the structural vibration and noise of the truck cab structures have been systematically simulated and studied with test modal technology, the finite element and the boundary element methods in this text. First, modal analysis is made to obtain the structure's modal parameters. Then, the finite element modal is checked and verified by the test results. The dynamic response is calculated based on the reliable finite element modal. Combine the boundary method and regard vibration pace of the panel as bound condition; based on the SYSNOISE software the structure acoustic couple cab modal is set. The acoustics characteristic of the indoor acoustic field is carried on analysis and research. The noise obtained within the driver's cabin is distributed, some conclusions were drawn which were useful for the vehicle reducing noise in low frequency.

articleTitle: Research on the construction of supply chain dynamic system based on adaptive control method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The adaptability of supply chain has become the most critical criteria to measure the performance of supply chain system. In this paper, facing with the complexity of adaptive supply chain system, combine adaptive control with expert auxiliary control; present a new method to adjust optimization strategies of supply chain timely, dynamically and automatically to adapt the dynamic environment, to help increase the active coordination of supply chain. The results provide the basis for next step detailed study.

articleTitle: A stage-gate model of new service development in China's financial industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper examines new service development research from the perspective of its relationship to allied field on service management and new product development (NPD) and takes Stage-Gate as base. This study designs a model of New Service Development (NSD) for China's financial industry including nine stages and five gates. The model will can help financial institution in China better complete new service development with shorter time, easy executive and more extension opportunities.

articleTitle: Underlying forces, characteristics analysis and essence judgment of forest ownership reform of Heilongjiang local state-owned forests
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The local state-owned forests of Heilongjiang Province are in the charge of Heilongjiang Forestry Department, and the management area takes 49.3% of the whole province. In order to solve the three prominent problems about forest regions, forestry and forest workers existed in the local state-owned forestry, Heilongjiang Forestry Department started to perform forestry ownership reform of state-owned forests in some counties (cities) and stated-owned farms and pastures in 2007. The paper starts from the analysis of the underlying forces of the reform. The research shows that the imbalance of system supply and demand, imperfectness of property ownership contracts, the active participation of forestry staff and the push of local government are the characteristics of the reform; the empowerment and regulation, redistribution of the benefits among relative bodies and compatibility of the new state-owned forest ownership system and other systems are the essence of the reform.

articleTitle: Identification dimensionality and evaluation model of regional coordination development: A theoretical framework
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The implementation of non-equilibrium development through non-balance policy among different regions is one of the most significant characteristics of China mode. The regional development mode supported by the regional plans and policies in China is stepping into regional coordination development after the stages of the initial development of the eastern area, development of the west, revitalization in the northeast, and rise of central region. Under the government-oriented market economy system, the orientation effect that local governments pursue the administrative achievements is the important interior motive for regional development. However, the performance appraisal mainly based on GDP will easily lead to the vicious competition together with similar structure among regions, the ignorance of interregional cooperation, and the friendly interaction with external environments. Meanwhile, the present regional development evaluation methods, which emphasize interior all-side elements and their quantity matching through the index setting in terms of dimensionality and weight, face the serious conflict against the real fact of regional division based on each advantage supported by resource endowment and regional cooperation based on exchange, inter-regional arrangement and hierarchical governments. Thus, it is quite necessary to construct a more reasonable method of regional coordination development evaluation. In this paper, according to system theory and coordination theory, a two-level and five-dimension analysis framework of regional coordination development is proposed, and a evaluation model for appraising the status of coordination development of both national level and regional level from the corresponding dimension is established.

articleTitle: Motivation management of English learning in college
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Students' learning motivation and study effect have become the focus of teachers and students, and effective motivation management of learning can help to improve students' study effect. In this paper, students' English learning motivation is classified by four categories: seeking knowledge type, achievement type, development type and passive coping type. And study effect includes written English scores and spoken English scores. The English learning status of 450 students in different colleges, majors and grades are sampled, and the analysis of correlations between different learning motivations and study effect is conducted with the statistical analysis software—SPSS. The statistical results show that study effect has a positive correlation with seeking knowledge type, achievement type, development type, and negative correlation with passive coping type. Then some management recommendations are put forward for the different motivations.

articleTitle: A concept framework for agri-food supply chain integration in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Supply chain integration is becoming an increasingly important area of research. This paper focuses on the research finding in agri-food supply chain integration in china. Based on the analysis of characteristics in China's agri-food supply chain, a framework for agri-food supply chain integration linking small scale farmers is presented. Integrating agri-food supply chains in China will help improve quality and safety of food products in the world.

articleTitle: A minimax inequality and its application to the existence of Pareto equilibria for multi-objective games in FC-spaces
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Minimax inequality plays a key role in the field of nonlinear analysis, for example, optimization problem, fixed point problem, non-cooperative game problem etc. In this paper, by using the continuous unity partition theorem and a famous fixed point theorem due to Górniewicz (1975), an important minimax inequality in FC-spaces is proved. On the basis of this inequality, following the method introduced by Nikaido and Isoda (1955), this paper defines an aggregate payoff function and furthermore determines some restrictions on the aggregate function that guarantee the existence of Pareto equilibrium for multi-objective games with infinite countable players. Our results generalize and improve the known Nash equilibrium existence results for multi-objective games with finite players in the literature.

articleTitle: The analysis of core stakeholders' role playing model in Green Administration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The Green Administration refers to the environmentally-friendly administration. Green administration activities aims at protecting natural resources and ecological environment, which can help to achieve sustainable development of society and economy. Using several methods such as literature review, expert interview and the theoretical analysis, the paper proposes that in the process of implementing green administration, various stakeholders should be involved, meanwhile identifies the core stakeholders of the green administration and their interests or claims, and constructs core stakeholders' role playing model in green administration. Finally, the paper makes some suggestions from the perspective of the core stakeholders in order to promote green administration.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of VoIP based on SIP in IPv6 circumstances
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With the comprehensive development of Next Generation Network (NGN), voice calls on IPv6 (VoIP over IPv6) is the general trend. This paper studies the core Signalling Conrol Protocol of NGN-SIP features and structure, analyzes the model based on SIP, researches the framework of voice within SIP, eventually proposed the way to complete VoIP in the environment of IPv6 with VC++.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of smart print information management platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development and extensive application of computer technology, information management has become an important direction for the reform and development of office information management. The rapid development of information technology pays a solid technical foundation for office information management. Information management platform can greatly improve work efficiency and service level. Therefore, information management platform has great significance in the modern management. In view of the above, the paper made a systematic study on design and implementation of smart print information management system platform which based on a modular structure and C/S architecture. First, the paper made an overall architecture and functional design for the system based on the analysis of workflow of the print work. It introduced the achievement of specific functional modules of the C/S part. Secondly, the paper made a research on Multi-layer structure design patterns. It made a realization of a modular-based, loosely coupled, maintainability, scalability, portability and reusability smart print information management platform in light of the actual demand. Finally, the paper discussed the security of the system on aspect of authentication, data backup and exception handling. At present, the system this paper talked about has been put into use and gets good results.

articleTitle: The influence of institutional investors' feedback strategies on the efficiency of security market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper examines the practical significance of encouraging institutional investors and strengthening the supervision to institutional investors, using the data of 18 stocks' Large-volume Trade on Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE) to signify institutional investors' behavior. In order to reveal the influence of institutional investors' feedback strategies on the efficiency of security market, we contrasted the efficiency of security market in two cases of institutional investors take positive and negative feedback strategies by building panel data model. Our research show that the mean square of price deviation is significantly higher than using negative feedback strategy when institutional investors to take positive feedback strategy, which means that institutional investors to take negative feedback strategies help to improve security market efficiency in China.

articleTitle: State-of-the-art in bank-to-turn missile control algorithms
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In this state-of-the-art paper, important advances that have been made during the past years for BTT (Bank-to-turn) missile control algorithms are described. The paper reviews approaches in BTT missile autopilot with a focus on the problems raised in practical implementations by their nonlinear and uncertain properties. After a brief introduction on BTT missile, the paper explores the state-of-the-art in classical control theory, modern control theory, intelligent control theory and their combination for missile control issues, with short discussions and comments. The paper is concluded with remarks and future directions.

articleTitle: The 6P's of Sales Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper will explore a data-driven approach called Sales Resource Management (SRM) that can provide real insight into sales management. The DSMT (Diagnosis, Strategy, Metrics and Tools) framework can be used to solve field sales management challenges. This paper focus on the 6P's strategy of SRM and illustrates how to use them to solve the CAPS (Concentration, Attrition, Performance and Spend) challenges.

articleTitle: Load balancing mechanism of RFID applications system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This thesis considers a scenario for RFID-based load balancing architecture for logistic applications, designs an improvement RFID load balancing architecture, and uses the grid technology to solve the overloading problem of RFID middleware. The results of performance evaluation and experimental simulation show that the proposed architecture can efficiently solve the overloading problem of RFID middleware. It could be proved that the operation of RFID load balancing architecture performs high reliable and has well effect.

articleTitle: A content analysis of social assurance statements in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper undertakes a detailed examination of content in a sample of 101 social assurance statements in China from 2006 to 2010, by using an evaluative framework developed from the main international guidances as AccountAbility, FEE, and GRI on social assurance practice. The results indicate the fact that Social assurance practice is evolving in China but still at its early stage, and it appears that the social assurance in China has done little to improve the completeness and creditability of social reports. These result in the incomparability of assurance information and limit the usefulness of assurance statements.

articleTitle: Development of the workshop tool management system with UML
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In manufacturing, a good workshop tool management system (WTMS) plays an important role for enterprise production planning system & the use of equipment capacity. By using Unified Modeling Language (UML), based on Use Case Diagram, Static Structure Diagrams, and Dynamic Behavior Diagram, the functional demands of workshop tool management system are analyzed. Thus the workshop tool management system model is established, and the Sub-function systems are designed in detail. Farther more, technical instrument of WTMS & key technology are systematically studied. And an example of WTMS prototype system has been put forward in the end.

articleTitle: Application of e-commerce in procurement management of enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Enterprise has gradually developed into national economic wealth creating force and plays an important role in the development of regional economic. Traditional enterprises purchasing models cannot tolerate a growing purchase scale, and it difficult to improve purchasing efficiency and reduce procurement costs. To organize and implement e-procurement is imminent. The purpose of this paper is to analyze application of e-procurement in enterprises. According to the role of e-commerce in enterprises, the paper dissects the superiority of the e-procurement over traditional modes and explores the approaches of e-procurement.

articleTitle: Research on the protection and limitation of the intellectual property on the international trade
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Currently there exists the inadequate protection and abuse of the intellectual property rights, and this phenomenon is closely related to the inadequate TRIPS provisions. In view of this, the balance significance and principle of the balance of the intellectual property protection and limitations is analyzed in this paper, and then the cooperation and consultation are proposed in international trade in order to perfect the mechanism of interests balance in TRIPS Agreement.

articleTitle: Intellectualized survival and product innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This article eleborates product innovation's principle to meet the demand of intellectualized survival. Improving the product innovation quality as the goal, it has carried on the elaboration from the perspective of the future. In the analysis intellectualization survival demand model and in the characteristic foundation, it proposed product innovation principle, method and mentality based on this kind of demand model and consideres that the intellectualized survival is the future development tendency, it has brought the momentum to the product innovation, as well as ethics risk, therefore the health and ethics, sustainable and other principles must be in line to promote product innovation and further enriched the theory.

articleTitle: Research on the producer services cluster based on knowledge spillovers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In this paper, firstly, we summarizes the classification of producer services through analyzing the signification of producer services. In addition, reviews traditional theories of industrial cluster and indicates those theories is not entirely applicable to the producer services cluster. Finally, proposes a new ideas for producer services cluster based on the “knowledge spillovers↔ collective learning↔cluster” positive feedback model.

articleTitle: Study on traffic demand management strategies of rail transit based on urban functional zoning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The current urban traffic demand of urban functional zonings is analyzed by studying the traffic characteristics. The modern urban transportation system of the urban rail transit as the backbone, supplemented by other public transport is studied. The unbalanced urban transport demand characteristics is found based on analyzing the utilization of transport capacity. There are adequate passengers during peak period, the city transportation system capacity was utilized fully. The relative scarcity passengers appear during conventional period flow period, which result in transport capacity idle and waste and affect the system resource utilization. To improve the resources effective of the urban rail transit system, increase the transport profits, the rail transportation demand management strategies are proposed for urban functional zoning.

articleTitle: A cross-case study on internal integration mechanisms of patent standardization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Patents standardization has become increasingly important for technological innovation and market competition. This article, utilizing a qualitative methodology, studies the R&D and patents standardization activities of nine representative optoelectronic information companies in Wuhan, and identifies the internal integration mechanisms that promote independent patents standardization. The mechanisms we find in this article, from one perspective, explain the determinants of patents standardization. Thus, it is important for strategic planning at the both macro and micro levels. Furthermore, the framework provides a basis for future research.

articleTitle: Fiscal revenue forecasting system research
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With computer technology and economic analysis methods, We can establish fiscal revenue forecasting system, which will enhance the timeliness and accuracy of the fiscal revenue forecasting, also can improve the science of the macroeconomic regulation and control. This article analyse the Linear regression model and the Autoregressive integrated moving average model which is used in fiscal revenue forecasting, make a fiscal revenue forecasting model of pingdingshan city in henan province of china with fiscal data from 1994 year to 2009 year, predict fiscal data from 2010 year to 2015 year of pingdingshan city. This article also analyse the whole solution of establishing fiscal revenue forecasting system, for example, develop software system, collect related data.

articleTitle: A hybrid ant colony algorithm for the Cutting Stock Problem
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This study presents a new hybrid ant colony algorithm (HACO) to solve an in integer linear programming formulation of the Cutting Stock Problem(CSP). The CSP is an important class combinatorial problem. It is appropriate to minimize the raw material used by industries for fulfilling customer's demands. In such cases, classic models for solving the cutting stock problem are useless. HACO consists of GDCP procedure and modified ACO (MACO). GDCP procedure provides dominative cutting patterns as MACO solution components, in MACO the pheromone trail is put on cutting patterns instead of items. MACO preserves cutting patterns and frequencies information under ants building solution procedure. Results obtained from computational experiments for ten benchmarks demonstrate that the performance of MACO is compared to that obtained using existing mete-heuristic algorithm.

articleTitle: Thinking on fair value measurement under the background of financial crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Fair value is a hot topic in international accounting development and research in recent years. The application of fair value measurements in accounting, not only to meet the requirements of accounting objectives, but also meet the definition of asset measurement and accrual basis of accounting recognition. So, it is widely used. However, with the occurrence of U.S. subprime mortgage crisis, fair value measurement is gradually being questioned; some people think that fair value should be abolished in the accounting. This article introduces the concept of fair value and the theoretical foundation of fair value, explains the specific reasons for financial crises, analyzes the relationship between the fair value and the financial crisis and thinks that fair value should not be repealed. Finally, gives some reasonable suggestions on the improving of fair value accounting.

articleTitle: Study on the model of preference convergence in group decision making based on inertia-PSO
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we constructed a dynamic preference convergence model based on inertia particle swarm optimization (inertia-PSO) algorithm, and we explored the effect of the knowledge propagation on dynamic preference convergence process. With the model, the effect of different types of knowledge propagation capability on preference convergence convergence is analyzed by simulation. Simulation results show that the higher the speed of knowledge propagation is, the more consistent the decision made is in the group.

articleTitle: The impact of TQM and interactivity on retention process in CRM context
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Total quality management is one of the outstanding tools emerged to help companies enhance the effectiveness and mostly concentrated in customer gratification. It is absolutely compatible in customer relationship environment. Customer retention has been one of the most significant phenomena in the work setting. Today, companies are challenging with each other, not only to win the customers also to grab the customers from each other in a secure and honest circumstance. Today, companies are encountering with mass of complaints, at the same time due to the complexity of business processes they suffer from lack of interactivity and they cannot retain their customer. In this paper, using TQM and interactivity within the CRM environment, we attempt to increase the level of customer retention. We then provide a secure environment for myriad transactions comprising virtual or physical exchanges; and diminish the level of customer complaints. We benefit from a conceptual framework to identify the problematic areas. We conclude this study with enhancement of customer satisfaction, profitability of the company as well as proper control over customers using conceptual framework.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A demonstration on the wealth effect of Chinese stock market based on rolling sample
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on water environment carrying capacity of Neijiang river basin in Zhenjiang City
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: According to the characteristics of water environment in Neijiang river basin, the index system of the water environment carrying capacity was divided into four subsystems, namely water resource, economy, population and water pollution. The judgment matrix of each subsystem internal index weight was obtained by analytic hierarchy process, and then to compute the index weight of the water environment carrying capacity. The water environment carrying capacity at current conditions was computed using the vector modulus based on SD model. The best adjustment scheme was the integrated approach gathering open source, water saving and contamination, by simulating different scheme to improve the water environment carrying capacity. Its water environment carrying capacity will be the most significant long-term growth and can satisfy the sustainable development of the Neijiang river basin.

articleTitle: The design and implement of file system based on Asix OS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The embedded real-time operating system is expected to process the massive real-time information and the historical data. Data files are stored in the large-capacity external storage media by file system, which allows users to read or write new information at any time. This article describes real-time embedded operating system Asix OS, which plays the software-platform role for file system. Then, the implementation of FAT file system is explained, including the design of file system storage management module, the design of file management module and the design of file system application interface module. All the work described in the paper has been finished. FAT file system based on Asix OS can steadily run in Garfield system and adopted the functional tests, including creating directory, deleting directory, opening document, wring document, deleting document and searching document.

articleTitle: Analysis and strategy of intellectual property rights innovation of self-brand car in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Development of self-brand intellectual property rights and core technologies for auto is top priority to China's self-brand auto companies. Along with the fast development of auto industry in China, the disadvantage in intellectual property rights obstructs development of self-brand car. The paper stressed on the current situation of intellectual property right, pointed out the main problems and put out further development strategy. Self-brand car companies should put more fund, manpower and resource on R&D, independent innovation and personnel training, to form a independent innovation platform, to enhance the core competitiveness for auto company.

articleTitle: An improved resource discovery algorithm in P2PGrid
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Grid computing and Peer-to-Peer (P2P) computing has many convergence features. In this paper, firstly a P2PGrid model is described, and then aimed at the fault of Chord resources discovery algorithm in structured P2PGrid environment, an improved Hilbert-Chord resources discovery algorithm is proposed, which utilizes Hilbert theory. Theoretical analysis and simulations prove that Hilbert-Chord resources discovery algorithm can improve the performance of grid resource discovery and better than traditional Chord resources discovery algorithm.

articleTitle: The studying of expert power using in channel management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This study contributes to existing studies of channel management by investigating expert power theory in a specific industry in China. Evaluating indicator had been come up with basing on expert power. This provides Chinese managers in the similar industry helpful suggestions to the issues of channel management.

articleTitle: Innovative management the resources of Zhejiang traditional Architecture-Culture in my opinion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Zhejiang traditional Architecture-Culture research and protection should be strengthened. An important factor is introducing the Management principles to scientific manage the Zhejiang traditional Architecture-Culture. Through the practical field investigation, both has analyzed present existence problems, and also analyzed the feasibility of using the Management principles in this field. At the same time, points out that introduce the management science principles to manage the Zhejiang traditional Architecture-Culture, including the two aspects of academic research and the protection of cultural relics. Thus can be further extending the ideas of creating a local culture brand and promoting local economic development.

articleTitle: Based on gray correlation degree of industrial development and economic growth analysis—Taking an example of key industries in Wuhan*
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In order to meet the requirement of “two-oriented society”, Wuhan City, as the central city of Wuhan city circle, has focused on the development of 18 industries in June, 2008. With gray correlation analysis method, this paper estimated the influence of 16 industries of them upon the economy of Wuhan; according to the results, it also analyzed these industries of Wuhan City have played important roles in economic development, but the structure among them is irrational. In addition, this paper made some suggestions about how to develop these industries in the context of “two-oriented society”.

articleTitle: Classifying scatterbrains by their reaction based on method of functional data
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we present a nonparametric statistical method for functional data analysis. We actually work with the functions obtained by taking logarithms of the densities and differentiating, one aspect of this transformation is that it makes a normal density into a straight line. We work with the probability density function, describing the reaction-time distributions. By studying a density function, we explore the use of functional principal components analysis to get a sense of how the density functions vary from student to student. The result of this paper is giving some help for computational classifying of human's attention with the aid of their reaction-time.

articleTitle: Application of irregular conduct theory in American Patent Law
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Irregular Conduct Theory in American Patent Law requires the patent applicant to fulfill the obligation of good faith and disclosure in the course of patent application, otherwise bear the serious consequence with invalid patent or can't be carried out. It aims at improving the quality of patent application and ensuring public interests. Because there is no single standard of constitutive requirements of irregular conduct at present, the court took shape when suitable to apply this theory and explained in pluralism. For many years, irregular conduct theory plays a positive role in encouraging applicants to fulfill the obligation of good faith. But with the expansion of this theory, its drawback displays gradually. First, the result is often contrary to the original intention of irregular conduct theory; Second, it has reduced the quality of patent application and increased the cost of patent inspection to a certain extent; Third, it has reduced the predictability of the law; Fourth, the passive legal consequence extends to the innocent. So, it is necessary to improve this theory.

articleTitle: On evolutionary game theory-based analysis and operation mode of subsidy policy on safety investment in SMEs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Because of the features of small size and lack funds of small and medium-sized enterprise (Abbr. SMEs) in our country, it has seriously effect on the safety situation of our country, and their own healthy growth. The evolutionary game theory-based modeling and stability analysis of subsidy policy on safety investment in SMEs is studied, and the operation mode of subsidy policy on safety investment is introduced. It indicates that the safety subsidy of local governments can enhance SMEs' enthusiasm to invest. In the operation process of subsidy policy in SMEs, the key factor is that the SMEs in time pay enough injury insurance, and the subsidized enterprises to invest matched funds to control safety risk. For relevant departments of local governments, supervision and law execution should be enhanced to ensure the operation effect. It has excellent significance to study further how to achieve equilibrium between SMEs and local governments using evolutionary game theory, and to provide theoretical basis to study operation mode of subsidy policy on safety investment in SMEs.

articleTitle: A research on minimum wage standard based on econometric model in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In this paper the econometric models is employed to determine the minimum living requirements (or poverty lines) of workers in China. Comparison between the actual minimum wage levels implemented by the Chinese government and the estimated minimum living requirements in this paper reveal that, in early 2010, workers in 18 out of 35 sample cities were paid minimum wages below the estimated lowest poverty line. This group of workers is unable to afford minimum payments to meet basic living conditions for survival as their minimum wages were below the estimated survival line. Related advice are addressed to the Chinese government to protect employee for basic living needs.

articleTitle: Research on the application of storage technology in Digital Library
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Along with the technical development of the computer and the network, Digital Library turns just in the essential development direction of libraries gradually. To face the needs of the leap digital information and the durative service to the readers, selecting high performance cost ratio and high available storage solution has become the hot problem of Digital Library study. In this paper, we will provide an overview of DAS, NAS and SAN, contrast the advantages and disadvantages of DAS, NAS, SAN storage technology, and offer a suggestion on how to choose the storage construction mode of Digital Library to keep the sustainable development of Digital Library storage construction mode.

articleTitle: Annotated dynamic texture graph
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: We introduce annotated dynamic texture graph (ADTG) for nonlinear motion synthesis, with applications to learning models of human pose and motion from capture data. Our method is based on clustering the motion data into motion primitives that capture local dynamical characteristics - dynamic texture, modeling the dynamics in each cluster using linear dynamic system (LDS), annotating those LDS' which have clear meaning and calculating the cross-entropy between frames of LDS' to construct a directed graph which has two-level structure. The lower level retain the detail and nuance of live motion, while the higher level generalizes motion and encapsulates connections among LDS'. Our results show that this framework can generates lifelike, controllable motion in interactive environments.

articleTitle: Research on rural emergency alarm system based on network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: As the huge rural people floating into the cities, for those old men and children who have to live in the village, the safety issues, especially the ones on the alarm and treatment on time during the emergency situation, need to be resolved urgently. The paper demonstrates a system that is composed of software and hardware, constructs its structure model and hardware and software functionality. The system can manage the stay-in-village elderly and children's information in an integrated interface, and make a rapid response with the help of the signal transceiver device which sends emergency calls and alarm. The system resolves the issue on the emergency security guarantee of the socially vulnerable groups, and contributes to the harmonious development of society.

articleTitle: Study on the construction of China national experimental chemistry teaching demonstration centres
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper aims to provide valuable experience to the laboratory of university by studying on the construction of China national teaching demonstration centre for chemistry experiment. This paper introduced experiment teaching, experiment management, experiment technician, experiment environment, and demonstration and diathermaneity of demonstration centre. For construction of China national teaching demonstration centre, the goal is to cultivate students' innovative ability in practice. Hence, the overall planning is necessary. At the same time, it is very important to prove the views above.

Author Keywords: China National Experimental Chemistry Teaching Demonstration Centres

articleTitle: Experimental investigation on sterilization effect by high concentration ozone water
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: High concentration ozone water has high efficacy in killing the selected model organisms (E. coli, Acinetobacter); As the applied ozone water dose (concentration) increased the inactivation rate of model organisms increased significantly; 1 ml of E. coli bacteria liquid (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> CFU /ml) can be Completely killed, with 2500 μL ozone water; 1ml of Acinetobacter bacteria liquid (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> CFU /ml) can be Completely killed, with 1750 μL ozone water; And the lasting effect of killing bacteria, no bacteria regeneration were got. E.Coli had stronger resistance to High concentration ozone water than Acinetobacter, and the inactivation rate were 0.192 min-1 and 0.2799 min-1 separately; The first order reaction dynamic model of Chick Model could embody the inactivation feature of E.Coli, Acinetobacter, the conclusion agree with experimental results.

articleTitle: Heuristic method for attribute reduction of concept lattice based on Boolean matrix
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The improved attribute reduction method based on Boolean matrix of rough set in Reference [6–9] transplanted to concept lattice field. Based on definition of Boolean matrix structural way and the attribute significance of concept lattice, A heuristic method for attribute reduction of concept lattice which save the distinguish attributes between the concept intention and its direct successor intention with Boolean matrix and adopt attribute significance as heuristic information is proposed. Finally, the feasibility and validity of the method are proved with examples.

articleTitle: A particle swarm optimized Fuzzy Neural Network for bankruptcy prediction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Since the excellent performances of treating nonlinear data with self-learning capability, the neural networks (NNs) are wildly use in financial prediction problem. But the NNs more or less suffer from the slow convergence, “black-box” i.e., it is almost impossible to analysis them for how they work. The Fuzzy Neural Networks(FNN) allow to add rules to neural networks. This avoids the black-box but lacks of effective learning capability. To overcome these drawbacks, in this study a particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed first, then combined with the fuzzy neural network to predict corporation bankruptcy. The results indicate that the predictive accuracies obtained from PSO-FNN are much higher than the ones obtained from NNs. To make this clearer, an illustrative example is also demonstrated in this study.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: CMC/PDM capsule immobilize catalase
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on mental damage of serious lakes pollution incidents from the perspective of accounting
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In order to safeguard the lawful rights of the lakes pollution victims, a study based on theories of the law and accounting were done for recognizing and measuring mental damage of serious lakes pollution, which can put forward a kind of measurement method to serve the judicial practice. Mental damage can be divided into three categories: the mental damage to property infringement, the mental damage to personal right infringement and the pure mental damage. Meanwhile, Delphi method was used to measure the mental damage to property infringement. Alternative method was used to measure the mental damage to personal right infringement and the pure mental damage.

articleTitle: American and German continuing education in IT industry and its enlightenment to China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: IT industry is a strategic industry of information era. The core competence of IT industry rests with its professionals and practitioners, so continuing education of IT industry is of vital importance. The article first analyzed two successful continuing education systems: CompTIA's Tech Career Compass of America and The Advanced IT Training System of German. Then analyzed present situation, existing problems of IT education in China, and put forward some advices to Chinese continuing education of IT industry based on comparative study.

Author Keywords: continuing education of America and German

articleTitle: Game analysis of value-effects of enterprise group based on financial cooperative control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Modern enterprise group is a product of organizational innovation to adapt to the changes of external environment and internal conditions, how to realize value creation abilities and levels have become the core and key factors of enterprise group's problem. This paper discusses the value-effects of financial cooperative control of enterprise group based on cooperative game. The result shows that: Firstly, the premise and basis for enterprise group to achieve maximum value-effects are cooperation among members what can be achieved by financial cooperative control. Secondly, the value increasing of α and β can improve the possibilities of enterprises' cooperation so as to ensure the increasing of total value-effects. Thirdly, the raising of value-effect coefficient γ can satisfy the necessary and sufficient condition for game parties to select “cooperation” tactics and also can be conducive to the improvement of value-effect of enterprise group.

articleTitle: The study on the relationship of internal control quality and audit fees
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In order to examine the economic consequences of internal control, we made a study on the relationship between the quality of internal control and auditfee by linear regression method, using the data from 1168 Shanghai and Shenzhen listed companies. The results as flow: internal control quality and audit fees have No-significant negative correlation, the auditor still control audit risk through substantive testing. The conclusion provide empirical evidence and theoretical basis, of cultivating endogenous requirements of internal control, and the establishment of internal control which adaptation to the Chinese national system .

articleTitle: Research on differential pricing model of closed-loop supply chain based on substitution
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Based on the consideration of the difference between a new product and a remanufactured product, this paper studies the product pricing model of a closed-loop supply chain which consists of a manufacturer, a retailer and a third-party. By the method of game theory, we analyze two differential product pricing models and obtain the optimal pricing strategies of supply chain members and the final system profits. Finally, through the numerical simulation, we make a further understanding of the impacts of the price fixing, recycled rate and total revenue that are caused by the change of parameter substitution coefficient and exogenous variable.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The analysis of financing structure of China's electronic manufacturing listed companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: An avoidance strategy for mobile robot in complex environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper presents an avoidance strategy for the robot to find the optimal trajectory to reach the target point in a complex environment. First, The robot's movement function is presented from the following three aspects. The first is that the robot motion must be in designated areas; the second is that the robot can reach the target location by the dynamic obstacle avoidance; and the third is the shortest movement path of the robot is guaranteed. Second, the conditions of the setting for the robot path optimization are given: they are the value of individual adaptation, re-optimization of path and mutation of movement strategy. The last, simulation results show that the proposed method is feasible.

articleTitle: The research on the auto dealers' Dual Brand Strategy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: By the adoption of the theory of the automobile industry value chain, the paper analyses the current situation and the tendency of China's auto dealers to explain its content, function and implementation. Then the paper proposes that the sustainable and healthy development of the auto dealer should rely more heavily on the self-service establishment and marketing service to win the customers' loyalty in the situation of more competitive auto market and more reasonable auto customers. The auto dealers should use the automobile brand efficiently and give priority to the auto dealer's market service brands so as to operate and develop the two brands.

articleTitle: The regional economic differences in Anhui province by fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper gives us an empirical study on the regional economic differences in Anhui Province by fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model. The deta include 17 cities in Anhui Province in 2008 per capita GDP, per capita revenues, per capita foreign trade, per capita domestic trade, ratio of primary industry output value, ratio of secondary industry output value, ratio of tertiary industry output value, actual utilization of foreign capital/GDP, total value of import and export commodities/GDP, employment rate, labor productivity, per capita growth rate of fiscal revenue, etc.

articleTitle: Comparison of normalized Expected Utility-Entropy investment decision model with Second Degree Stochastic Dominance criterion in stock selection?
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The normalized Expected Utility-Entropy (EU-E) investment decision model, which is a weighted linear average of normalized expected utility and information entropy, are introduce at first. Then, both normalized EU-E investment decision model and Second Degree Stochastic Dominance (SSD) criterion are used to stock selection among 40 sample stocks of Shenzhen component index to invest and compose portfolios of selected four stocks. It has been concluded that portfolios of stocks selected by normalized EU-E decision model have larger returns with fixed risk than those of stocks selected by SSD criterion under certain kind of risky decision situation. This is a further demonstration that information entropy is a useful measure of uncertainty of the state of nature when taking risky decisions. By comparing the computing processes of these two methods, it is easy for investor to select stocks by using normalized EU-E decision model than by using SSD criterion. Thus, the normalized EU-E investment decision model is a better decision criterion in this kind of investment decision making.

articleTitle: The effects of financial openness to trade structure of different type of countries
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Financial openness improves the financial development by affording more contenders in the country. And then financial development affects the competent advantages of the country. According to HO theory and New Trade Theory, the paper induces the effects of financial openness to trade structure of different type of countries by building a mathematics model. In the country with high degree of financial openness, services with high intelligences and technologies which have more exports replace the traditional industry with fewer exports. In the country with dual economy, financial openness has appropriate affections to different enterprises and net exports are uncertain in short time. In the country with low degree of financial development, financial openness can rapidly improve the financial effectiveness and economic growth.

articleTitle: Research and exploration on ERP shop activity scheduling based on cost optimization model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Job activity shop scheduling problem is widely used in actual production. It is the key ERP systems, but also the most difficult combinatorial optimization problems. This workshop production model under the given business process model based coding design approach, and based on this encoding optimized cost model of job shop scheduling.

articleTitle: Early-warning system design for collegial mass emergency based on case-based reasoning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: By employing case-based reasoning, five composed modules of early-warning system for collegial emergency are brought forward. On this basis, two subsystems - knowledge discovery and case-based reasoning - compose the structural framework of the early-warning system and the operational principle are given. Moreover, the probable tech-bottleneck of the key details is brought forward and the possible solution is given, such as case database building, case knowledge representation, case retrieval, case adjustment and case learning.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation on scientific research items in regular HEIs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper constructs index system of performance evaluation considering output of funded project on-campus (such as reporting the number of high level-projects, papers, books, patents based on this) as the parameter, and uses analytic hierarchy process to determine index weight as well as build evaluation model, which can reflect capacity and level of researchers. The classification and subtotal of model data will provide proof for school scientific management to develop relevant policies, so it plays a guiding role to some extent.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on the integrated path and mode of eco-industrial chain in mining area
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A port of call selecting model of proforma scheduled voyage line for liner shipping companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The significance of point to point services has gradually declined and increasingly the trend is to develop complex liner service networks, which rely on the hub-and-relay concept. This enables the liner operators to increase the port coverage with only marginal increase in cost. As a result, slots chartering and/or vessel sharing and other types of collaboration arrangements have evolved, which enable optimized returns in an ever-increasing cost environment. In this ever-increasingly competitive market, it is crucial for liner operators to plan carefully their service networks, which in turn directly affect the cost, revenue and customer service. The liner companies set liner routes by investigating the container amount between each two ports. To select the most suitable ports, we have analyzed the procedures of setting liner routes in order to have a deep study in the voyage costs. And finally a model is formulated to maximize the profits of the voyage. A deal of numerical experiments have been done to prove the feasibility and effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: The reconstruction of enterprises' core competences after the financial crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Under the drives and pressures of the global financial crisis, the China's Economic restructuring and the economic cycles, Chinese enterprises are entering into an era of thorough transformation and upgrade. In order to rebuild Chinese enterprises, the rational allocation of production factors must be relied on to complete enterprise transformation; their core competences must be strengthened through continuous innovation; the production efficiency can be improved through the fine management and eventually business growth can be achieved.

articleTitle: An approach of auto-offsetting the wrong-mark cargos in general cargo terminal
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Manual calculation is still mostly used for the offset in general cargo terminal, rather than some supporting software. With the analysis of import process in general cargo terminals, this paper established a multi-objective model for automaticly offsetting the loss bill of cargos by the wrong-marked cargos. We develop a decision-making system to do the offsetting calculation work. The feasibility and effectiveness have been proved by a deal of numerical experiments and actual system test. Moreover, the system provides a user-friendly graphical interface and has high application value.

articleTitle: FDI and TFP evolution of private manufacturing sectors in Jiangsu province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Using panel data of 2000–2007 years, FDI technology spillover is found in private manufacturing enterprises of Jiangsu province. The result indicates that the total factor productivity of private enterprises has gained a growth rate about 7.7% per annum. The technology change is the key element of the growth of total factor productivity. The horizontal, the forward and the backward spillover promote the growth of total factor productivity by upgrading the technology change. But the technology efficiency puts a negative effect to the total factor productivity on some extent. The backward connection spillover can promote the pure technology efficiency and the technology spillover within industry is beneficial to the scale efficiency.

articleTitle: Re-engineering of design and construction process for concurrent in construction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper introduced the construction concurrent design and construction patterns. And used design structure matrix as concurrent project's information flow analysis tool. Then build a task dependence fuzzy design structure matrix for concurrent design and construction process, thus receive a new method for re-engineering construction concurrent design and construction process.

articleTitle: Survey of CCD image mosaic techniques
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The paper gave a systemic introduction on the mosaic significance of images taken by the ordinary CCD imaging devices and on the problems easily arising from the course of image mosaics. Then, introduced and discussed recent algorithm as well as classical algorithm of the two main image mosaic methods: Region-based and Feature-based. Especially expounded the application of wavelet transformation in the feature-based mosaic methods. At last looked into the future of image mosaic techniques.

articleTitle: The evaluation of enterprises' independent innovation capacity of the large & medium-sized industrial enterprises in Bohai Sea Rim based on Catastrophe Progression Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: For the subjectivity in weight evaluation which is in the methods of Analytic Hierarchy Process, Factor Analysis and Fuzzy Cluster Analysis, etc widely used during the evaluation of enterprises' independent innovation, the Catastrophe Progression Method(CPM) is introduced to evaluate the capacity. The evaluation process of CPM is given and then an empirical research with large & medium-sized industrial enterprises of the seven provinces in Bohai Sea Rim is made. Empirical results show that the capacity distribution in this area looks like two ribbons of C which are different to each other in structure. Meanwhile, the capacity in this area increases towards a certain point in Bohai Bay along three different directions.

articleTitle: The research on the legal protection of High Technology intellectual property
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Intellectual property rights are becoming increasingly important for the survival and development of hi-tech enterprises. Nowadays, there exist various problems in the protection and management of intellectual property, which lead to numerous losses. Therefore, it is advisable to improve the legal system about the administrative protection of intellectual property rights in hi-tech enterprises, as well as strengthen the intellectual property management system, establish an effective and rigorous system of intellectual property protection. Meanwhile, we should, by employing scientific strategic measures of directing staff to make the most of intellectual property, attaching great importance to patent documents, enhancing innovative ability, implementing patent strategy, as well as forming technology alliance, to protect hi-tech intellectual property rights and make full use of them.

articleTitle: A new modulation and demodulation scheme
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Recently, because of the increase in spectrum demand, sine-like modulation has been proposed. In this new scheme, the side band of power spectrum density is rather low, so that it wouldn't cause interference to other signals. In this paper, we proposed a new kind of sine-like modulation, and also analyzed the corresponding demodulation scheme in detail.

articleTitle: Dual-supervisor structure and the design of collusion-proof mechanism for military equipment procurement system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In the aim of reducing the cost of the collusion proof mechanism and improving the welfare of military equipment procurement system, a dual-supervisor management structure is constructed. Under this supervisory structure, a collusion-proof mechanism is designed. Under the designed supervisory structure and collusion-proof mechanism, it is proved that the cost for avoiding collusion is reduced, and the welfare of the military equipment procurement system is improved. To further increase the procurement welfare, the research suggests different incentive reward allocation method to the two supervisors under different conditions.

articleTitle: A performance evaluation model for cooperation and exchange projects of NSFC
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Cooperation and exchange activities have become indispensable part of R&D, and performance of it is also concerned by many scientists and managers. A logic model of performance evaluation oriented to R&D projects with cooperation and exchange was discussed by focusing on International Cooperation and Exchange (ICE) projects in National Science Foundation of China (NSFC). After features of ICE projects were introduced, performance mechanism of ICE projects was analyzed. Moreover, framework of performance evaluation was specially highlighted from four dimensions based on discussion of general process of these R&D activities, and related key issues and major indicators were presented as well.

articleTitle: The study of E-commerce application in foreign trade enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With the development of Internet, E-commerce becomes a common practice in foreign trade and penetrates into every aspect of international trade. In this paper, the state of E-commerce application in foreign trade enterprise are analyzed, the potential application that E-commerce is superior to traditional trade is expounded, active reactions are suggested be taken, the promotive function of E-commerce application should be exerted by government, the enhancement of E-commerce competence, the perfection of the service role as intermediary platform, the study of joint effort of all parties for a promising E-commerce application environment.

articleTitle: Small low-cost production used in the course design of High-frequency Electronic Circuits
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Course design of High-frequency Electronic Circuits is an important practiced process of the course,which has irreplaceable role in the realization of the training target for electronics and communications students. Through the implementation of curriculum design, students can understand the basic theoretical knowledge better; master the key technology and improve the ability of training, design thinking and innovation. Small low-cost production is the title among the courses, from which, we can arouse the practical ability of students, let students finish the processes of schematic design, component selection, circuit debugging. Students can combine theory and practical knowledge to enhance their ability and the role course design of High-frequency Electronic Circuits can be achieved really.

articleTitle: Cognitive models and predicaments in reservoir resettlement projects in Chinese ethnic minority areas —A case study of Zhuang Ethnic group
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Chinese government and the state-owned companies built many dams in ethnic minority areas in recent years, which lead to many resettlement projects. Those projects have good experiences as well as many risks and resistances. Why those development projects have so many risks and resistances, the main explanation focus on the shortcoming of institutions and investment, the inefficacy of management methods. This paper analyses this kind of phenomena in other perspective. Using the ethnographical methods of fieldwork, the paper finds that three main stakeholders involve in those resettlement programs. Because their cognitive models are very different, the contradictions and conflicts are inevitably. Especially, the immigrant's cognitive models opposed to the anther stakeholders' models, which lead to political risks sprightly. At last, the paper provides a new tactic that resettlement projects should consider not only the institution building and more investment, but also the immigrants' cognitive models and the cultural demand.

articleTitle: Research on the enterprise cost management mode under cleaner production
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: At present, cleaner production has been an inevitable trend, and the contradiction between high input and cost control makes it necessary to find a new mentality of cost management under cleaner production. This paper analyzed the necessity of cost management under cleaner production and established the cost management mode of cleaner production including the target, content and foundation of cleaner production cost management.

articleTitle: Research on the effect of top management compensation encouragement on machinery and equipment enterprises performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we study the effect of top management compensation encouragement on machinery and equipment listing enterprise performance in 2006–2008. The results show that rational compensation structure, compensation level and compensation changes of top management in the listed enterprises can promote firm performance significantly. When the population proportion of top management that owns stock is low, the top management stock ownership has a negative impact on firm performance.

articleTitle: A preliminary study on the method of performance measurement for staff based on principal-agent model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Through establishing the multi-duty principal-agent model, this article has analyzed the influences to firm performance by different performance incentive, and research the relevance between the different performance index. Furthermore, this model quantitative analysis the quantitative relations which influence the firm performance index. According the model, it can confirm the pay contract and can soundly direct how to effectively weight the performance of the staff.

articleTitle: A quantum key distribution protocol of resisting combined noise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: We present two different efficient quantum key distribution schemes over two different collective-noise channels. One is the phase noise, and the other is rotating noise. For the phase noise, we proposed a scheme of using GHZ state. Through the channel of the phase noise, the phase factor e<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">iϕ</sup> can be put forward as a whole phase, with the purpose of resistance to phase noise. For the rotating noise, we proposed a scheme of using Bell state, when the noise through the rotating channel, the impact of the noise can be effectively against.

articleTitle: Design and study of piezoresistive polycrystalline silicon sensor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Piezoresistive polycrystalline silicon sensor has the advantages of high sensitivity and nice stability as well as not hard to manufacture, so it is suitable for measuring the ultra-micro pressure. The mature polycrystalline silicon is adopted as sensitive material for the sensor in this paper. Two island-beam structure is used as the chip; stress dissipative structure has been designed; the mask structure is discussed in detail. The sensor can match the need of ultra-micro pressure measurement and overload protection. A detailed study of the structure is developed by the applications of finite element analyses (FEA) software. The study offers important reference to the optimization of the sensor chip.
