Finally, the paper studies the static and dynamic performance of the sensor. We find that the structure we designed here has good linearity, high overload protection and good sensitivity. It is suitable for measuring 500Pa micro pressure.

articleTitle: Research on the total factor productivity of manufacture industry in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Compared with others, manufacturing industry in china, one of the most important sectors of the national economy, is the engine of promoting the high-speed advancement of the whole national economy. The advancement of national economy mainly depends on the development of manufacturing industry. Many methods can be used to measure the total factor productivity of manufacture industry, the author makes use of DEA-based Malmquist productivity index approach to calculate the change trend of total factor productivity (TFP) during 1995 to 2007, and decomposes the TFP into two components: technological progress and technological efficiency. The empirical results shows that the average increasing rate is 10.9% for manufacturing industry in china during the period, and it has a obvious difference in the contribution of total factor productivity under the terms of technologic rate and technique improvement in different eras. Consequently, this investigation provides some implications for researchers and decision makers.

articleTitle: Empirical research on enterprise organizational capability evaluation system based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Enterprise organizational capability is the source to maintain enterprise competitive advantage and cultivate enterprise core competence. How to scientifically evaluate the effect of organizational capability is the key to keep on top of organizational capability. Firstly, this paper introduces the enterprise circumstances and the concept of the enterprise organizational capability. Secondly, in reviewing enterprise organizational capability and the evaluation index, construct evaluation index system of enterprise organizational capability model. Finally, through the application to AHP, examples demonstrate the application of this evaluation method, in order to provide reference for enterprise organizational capability evaluation.

articleTitle: The Relevancy factors of college students scientific innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Scientific and technique innovation practice by college students as an approach improving college students' accomplishment is an important part of China's reform especially in higher education and science area in this new era. By analyzing the internal requirements (such as psychological quality, practical ability and knowledge level. ect.) and external factors (such as policies, campus environment and social atmosphere, etc) which affect the practice of college students and their affections, the paper studies the method to establish an innovation platform system specific to college students' scientific activities.

articleTitle: Business to family e-commerce enterprises analysis: A case study of Redbaby
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Redbaby, established in 2004, was devoted to provide consumers with a convenient way of shopping and quality products with low prices via catalog selling and e-commerce website. The products for sale have extended from one category to nine categories that could entirely meet the requirement of family shopping. Redbaby has transferred itself from a traditional baby-care products seller to a shopping platform on families, which is a model change from B2C to B2F (Business to Family). After years of development, Redbaby has established the operation with catalog and website as the channel, and integrated marketing center, purchasing center and operating center as a system. The paper analyzes the running model of Redbaby comprehensively from the perspective of operation, technology, capital and logistics.

articleTitle: Conceptual design of method alternatives based on the multi-objective Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Product Conceptual Design phase is the most important period, the process of scheme generation can be regarded as a progress of optimization in a state space. In this process, there are often conflicts between multiple objectives and multiple constraints, we can only produce a compromise set. Based on Technology Identification Evaluation and Selection method (TIES), constructing the mapping relations from different functional principles combination to design objectives, we applied the improved Non-dominated sorting Genetic Algorithm (NSGA-II) to multi-objective optimization, so as to make it more suitable for the characteristics of combinatorial optimization, forming the pareto frontier of design space, facilitating the experts to make selection based on different target orientation.

articleTitle: Optimal form & deadline for paying insurance agents their commission
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In view of this question, whether lengthening the deadline of commission payment can effectively restrict the occurrence of myopia action of the insurance agent, a long-term principal-agent model and a model of the best deadline of commission payment are established. It's proved that the optimal insurance contract must have the part of fixed wages. A formula for the best deadline of commission payment is given. Meanwhile the models of the reference [1], [2], and [3] are improved, and also some conclusions of those references are strengthened.

articleTitle: Methods research for removing the stripe noise based on AVIRIS images
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Stripe noise existing in all of remote sensing image which use of multiple detectors seriously affected the image quality. The existing stripe noise filtering methods have focused on the relatively narrow bandwidth or the law distribution stripe noise. However, because of different imaging mechanism, any width of the band may exist in the actual remote sensing images. Therefore, this paper presents an improved method of stripe noise elimination. This method is not subject to the restriction of band width and periodicity. It can automatically classify and smooth the stripe noises within any rows in AVIRIS image. By simulating on AVIRIS image, we can prove that this method can not only remove the stripe noises, but also can better ensure the quality of the image.

articleTitle: Study on the fuzzy-controlled plantation pruning robot
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a novel fuzzy-controlled robot is developed, which can solve equipment clumsiness, labor intensity and safety problems in our current plantation pruning process. Prototype machine is designed and presented which can exactly find tree branches and prune them efficiently and fluently. The good performance of pruning robot with high automatic and convenient operations is proved via practical tests.

articleTitle: The policy system innovation for the development of low-carbon economy in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The development of low-carbon economy is an inevitable choice for China to realize the sustainable development. In order to achieve this purpose, the government must strengthen the regulation and control of macroeconomic economy. The policies should be changed to move the rules and the organizational structure of economic society in China. The current policies are mainly associated with some administrative measures, such as “command-control”, which hinders the development of low-carbon economy. Hence, low-carbon economy policies in China should follow the market-oriented reform process and the policy system design should be changed form relying on administrative means to relying on market mechanisms, such as tax policy, fiscal policy, credit policy, price policy.

articleTitle: The research of minimum cost based on lamp design of urban planning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With the high-speed economy development, urban construction steps has increased. With the corresponding support facilities in the development, the input has improved obviously. Lamp is a typical. How to reasonably achieve overall planning for streetlights highest efficiency? It becomes study hotspot. By analyzing examples, use mathematical knowledge to design model, and then to achieve optimization.

articleTitle: The trade effect analysis of foreign direct investment in Hebei
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Foreign trade is an important part of economic development, and there is a close relationship between foreign direct investment and foreign trade, therefore, it is possible to through the adjustment of foreign direct investment to promote foreign trade in Hebei. This paper introduce the Substitution of trade and Trade complementarities, studied the relationship between FDI and foreign trade by multiple linear regression analysis, and put forward some suggestions about how to promote development of foreign trade with FDI.

articleTitle: Face recognition using wavelet transform and Kernel Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: A novel face recognition method using wavelet transform and Kernel Principal Component Analysis (KPCA) was presented. The method calculated logarithm transform and 2-dimensional wavelet transform for face pre-processing, used KPCA algorithm for face feature extraction, and adopted nearest neighborhood classifier based on Cosine distance for feature classification. The experimental results on Yale B frontal face database show that the face recognition rate of the proposed method can attain 100%. That is, the proposed approach can alleviate variable illumination for face recognition and identify all test samples on Yale B frontal face database accurately‥

articleTitle: Research on enterprises collaboration to promote harmonious development of low-carbon economy in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: At present, how to develop low-carbon economy is an essential strategy which may both decelerate climate warming and accelerate economic recovery in Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei. Through survey, we find that the enterprises have positive response to this strategy. Under the analysis of these enterprises facing new opportunities and new tasks, this paper considers that in order to both further complete the national task of China's energy conservation and emission reduction and enhance the regional low-carbon competitiveness, the three governments need for policy innovation, and thereby achieving the harmonious development of low-carbon economy by enterprises collaboration.

articleTitle: Promotion operation scheme and design of e-commerce website in small and medium garment enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Design and produce the e-commerce website to meet the requirements does not mean that the work has been completed, how to run the websites, and how to run it smoothly, how to finish the website maintenance and management lately, what conditions do the garment enterprises need to their websites, and practical feedback from Garment companies, these are all important work required after the design and production of the website. It will directly influence the website of good Performance effect and e-commerce sales performance if any of these left unfinished. This paper takes the Chinese small and medium-sized Garment enterprise e-commerce sites, for example, small garment enterprises of the actual conditions of the e-commerce sites operation conditions and maintenance of the design to argument.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Preparation of chitosan / CMC capsule and immobilized sucrase
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Study on application of synergetics in the sustainable development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Sustainable development is the important development strategy, and is of decisive significance for social and economic development. Synergetics is the important theory studying the open complex system. In the view of synergetics, this paper analyzes and discusses the synergetic effect and the evolution in the sustainable development system, and offers government management decisions some enlightenment from synergetics for reference.

articleTitle: Security analysis on a verifiably encrypted signature scheme
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Recently, a randomized verifiably encrypted signature scheme without random oracle is proposed by Yang et al. However, according to the security analysis, it is found that given two signatures on a message, the adversary can forge a new signature on the same message. Therefore, their scheme has not the propriety of undenibility, which means that their scheme is insecure. Because a verifiably encrypted signature scheme is mainly used to construct the optimistic fair exchange protocols, it should have the strong unforgerity.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Impacts of career orientation and job satisfaction on turnover intention for key talents: An empirical study from Henan high-tech enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: An intelligent agent-based meta search
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: By combinating agent theory and meta search engine, design a reflecting individual query meta search engine model which has a reasonable structure, excellent functionality, and providing integration technology related areas. It is better to help users quickly and accurately search the information to their needs.

articleTitle: The real estate price puzzle in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The article is using the statistic data through regression to explain the non-stopping price increase of real estate in China. According to our research, the large increase of real estate is mostly due to the price increase of land and the over supply of money.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on the management ethics in performance management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of stress dissipative structure sensor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The sensitivity and linearity are main parameters of piezoresistive pressure sensor. And the diaphragm structure of sensor' chip has a significant impact on sensitivity and linearity. For this reason, this paper analyses and calculates the diaphragm parameters of the sensor chip. The stress dissipative structure has been designed in this paper, and the mask structure is discussed in detail. Related Properties, such as sensitivity, linearity and frequency et al, have been calculated by the applications of finite element analyses (FEA) software. So, this paper, for accelerating the design of sensor chip, offers an valuable foundation.

articleTitle: A method for evaluating the situation of safety production based on DEA and AHP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Evaluation of the safety production situation is a multi-objective decision-making problem. In this paper, the comprehensive index system of capital safety production was firstly set up, which including inherent risk, supervision personnel allocation, regional economy, accident, supervision and management capacity and development potential. Secondly, 23 second-level indexes were combined to 6 third-level indexes using the AHP approach. The DEA model with weight constraints was proposed to evaluate the situation of safety production. Finally, as an illustration, the proposed method was applied to evaluate the situation of safety production in 18 districts of Beijing during each month of 2009. The case study shows that the proportion of districts whose compositive index of safety production equals 1 to all is small, and the supervision and management level of every district need to be improved.; there is no big difference in the situation of districts; seasonal difference in the situation is detected (the compositive index in January, February, and March of 2009 is higher than other months).

articleTitle: The research on multi-state search algorithm in radio frequency identification system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: For radio frequency identification systems, multiple tags exchange data with the reader and cause collision problems. It makes use of an improved multi-state binary search algorithm, which according to the features of tags collisions, make full use of the collision information which have been obtained, adopt sleep counting strategy, introduce preconditioning mechanism to effectively reduce the total number of commands sent and each parameter's length. Simulation results show that the algorithm can rapidly and effectively identify the electronic tags, and with the increasing tag number and tag code length, the advantages become more prominent.

articleTitle: Personnel management of scrum agile software development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Scrum agile software development is not only a methodology, but also a management. Through elaborated the importance of personnel in the Scrum agile development process, analyzed Scrum team composition and the working environment, illustrated the assessment of productivity, and proposed the rewards and punishment measure to improve management effectiveness, analyzed in detail the “people-oriented” core idea, puts forward an effective management method and mode for Scrum personnel management.

articleTitle: Research on the causes and control measures of the marketing channels conflict of Chinese home appliance industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With the deeper degree marketization and the formation of buyers' market, Chinese home appliance industry is facing with the increasingly fierce competition. In this process, the marketing channels conflict has become a major barrier to the development of home appliance industry. The author used the survey and case analysis and induction methods in the article and found the malignant falsifying, dependence on distribution channels and logistics chaos were the culprit of the conflict. Then the article provided the measures of controlling it based on the above analysis. The article is useful to promote a more thorough understanding of the marketing channels conflict of Chinese home appliance industry and find effective ways to control it.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The research of the establishment for human resource accounting system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on military equipment maintenance and management system having information as the core
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: At the present time, traditional management ideas and means for equipment maintenance are facing to enormous challenge. In an era of information, the core of equipment maintenance and management should be based on information, and improve equipment maintenance benefit by analyzing and dealing with information. The paper analyses the meaning and characters of equipment maintenance based on information, brings forward an academic framework and discuss some problems in actual application. In the end, some intending research advices are given out.

articleTitle: On strategy-oriented local party and government leaders environment protection performance Assessment Indicator System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The text summarize how to make environment protection strategy of local government, by analyzing key success factors of local environment protection through brain storm, discomposing from the up down key success factors of local environment through strategic goals correlations, and abstracting Local Party and Government Leaders key environment protection performance indicators through fishbone diagram as a process in making environment protection performance indicators of the leaders; analyze how to choose subject of local party and government leaders environment protection performance assessment by subject method of stakeholders; how to design weights of the assessment through Delphi method, etc. to systematically build Strategy-Oriented Local Party and Government Leaders Environment Protection Performance Assessment Indicator System, which is expected to have some policy implication in building Local Party and Government Leaders Environment Protection Performance Assessment Indicator System in China..

articleTitle: Parallel 3D imaging based on Linux cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Digital processing for large size image is the key step for three-dimensional image direct writing field. A challenging task for processing of large size image is to minimize the computation time within the time limited by industrial standard. To accelerate computation speed for image processing, a parallel 3D imaging processing method on Linux cluster is proposed. Experiment results show that the method possesses high effectiveness, reliability in 3D imaging processing.

articleTitle: An analysis of factors affecting management compensation of power enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper selects power enterprises in 2004–2008 Shanghai and Shenzhen as the sample and empirical analysis of the influence factors of management compensation on the sample companies. This article supposes 6 independent variables and study the relationships with management compensation. The empirical results show that enterprise scale, location of the enterprise, compensation committee, ownership balancing degree, age of senior managers are positively related to management compensation, but ROE doesn't make any sense. These results may provide a good view to reform the management compensation. With the result in this paper, we have some suggestions. Power enterprises should improve its scale - pay salary system, make salary structure diversification. Pay attention to long-term incentive plan, perfect the performance appraisal system, make the close relationship between profit and management compensation. Adjusting the government behavior, improve the external environment; cultivate the professional manager market, at the same time.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Managerial overconfidence and firm expansion: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The impact of life stress on job satisfaction: A multilevel study
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The purpose of this study was to explore the relationship between life stress and job satisfaction. Participants were 6,873 residents from 154 cities and counties in China. The authors used hierarchical linear model to investigate the relationship. Results indicate a significant relationship between life stress and job satisfaction in individual-level and group-level. Additionally, life stress in cites and counties level (group-level) moderates the relationship between life stress and job satisfaction in individual-level. Limitations of the study and implications of these findings are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on problem of prevention and control of the listed companies' financial risk in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Along with the deepening of integration and globalization of the economic, the environment enterprises are facing becomes complex increasingly. Business risk is also showing a trend of diversification. In particular, many companies due to excessive debt, blind diversification, ignore the importance of cash flow and disordered distribution of income; lead to financial risk has increased drastically. Listed company as a typical representative of quality of economic resources, excellent operating performance is the capital market to maintain a solid foundation for longterm viability, also improve the competitiveness of the national key. This article in and forms the reason analysis to Chinese listed companies financial risk present situation in the foundation, proposed that to be listed companies raise early warning, control and prevention of financial risk measures, for listed companies healthy and sustainable development to provide useful lessons and help.

articleTitle: Evaluation method for collaboration degree in knowledge collaboration team
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Knowledge collaboration team is an important organization form for knowledge innovation. Its collaboration degree affects the performance of knowledge innovation seriously. This paper firstly explains the concepts and characteristics of knowledge collaboration and knowledge collaboration team, and gives definitions of collaboration relation matrix, collaboration degree matrix and collaboration relation weight matrix for knowledge collaboration team. Then, a method based on 2-tuple linguistic information processing is proposed to evaluate the total collaboration degree of knowledge collaboration team. According to the new 2-tuple linguistic concept, the method processes linguistic evaluation information using with aggregation operators. The obtained evaluation result has important reference value for improving the total collaboration degree of knowledge collaboration team.

articleTitle: Research on rough sets theory based tax data mining
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In order to conduct effectively data mining to the abnormal data in the mass tax data to get decision rules of tax information system, a decision rules mining algorithm based on positive approximation is proposed, which is based on the traditional rough set theory and the decision-making table of coordination. A practice applied in tax monitoring table in a tax department is validated, which shows that the algorithm is simple and effective.

articleTitle: Investment risk evaluation of hi-tech projects based on projection pursuit model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The hi-tech projects' investment is characterized with high risk and huge profit, so a scientific and accurate risk evaluation model is of importance to projects' investment. Based on the analysis of the indicators influencing the investment risk of hi-tech projects, some typical indicators were selected. Firstly, according to the quantitative assessment results from the experts, some samples were used to establish the projection pursuit model for comprehensive evaluating the investment risk of the hi-tech projects. Then, the model without samples was constructed to avoid the impact of training samples. The optimal projection vector was optimized by genetic algorithm, so the above problem was transformed into one dimension problem. Compared with the conventional assessment methods such as AHP (Analytic Hierarchy Processing) and ANN (artificial neural net), the model can effectively overcome the faults of the subjective feature from the AHP and unsatisfied generalization ability from ANN. Additionally, under no training samples, the model can also sort well, so the model has wide applicability.

articleTitle: Research of digital campus application system integration based on mobile phone card
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Campus card system in schools based on the original campus network, using advanced technology, non-touched IC card for data collection function to the data into a unified campus network management platform, this Article design of the overall system software consumption system design, water control system design, settlement systems design and application of the school described several aspects.

articleTitle: Knowledge management modes and strategies for university libraries
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the study focuses on the knowledge management modes and strategic framework of the university library. First of all, taking the development model of the enterprises' knowledge management as the reference, the research is on the basis of the descriptions of the explicit knowledge and tacit knowledge management processes and the changing role of the university library in the knowledge management. Certain management modes of the university library have been put forward. Then the analysis has been taken on the elements of the library in the knowledge management: knowledge, users, learning organization, interaction and sharing, managers etc., and the proposition has been given about five knowledge management strategy, including organizational culture construction of a university library in knowledge management, information and communication technology supported service system, collaborative learning organization, performance evaluation of knowledge management, and user information archives. The research findings provide a reference for establishing and developing a new model of knowledge management for the university library.

articleTitle: A study on the new method to measure the increment of enterprise's human capital
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The paper uses C-D production, estimates parameter by means of regression analysis, and calculates the human capital contribution to firm's value. Compared with the human capital investment, we get the human capital appreciation and through the time series analysis, summary on the general tendency of human capital appreciation, in order to enrich the human capital theory of value measurement

articleTitle: The practice of integrated water resource management in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Integrated water resource management (IWRM) and its implications are presented. It is an integrated process that allows stakeholders develop water resources sustainably. Sustainable water resource system makes support long-term development, no destruction of hydrological and ecological integrity as the goal. IWRM is by the goal, institutions, implement, and adapt to reflect the merger of top-down and bottom-up approach. Large-scale adoption of IWRM is comprised of objectives, institutions, implementation, and adaptation, reflecting merging of top-down and bottom-up approaches. With the development of economy, there exists conflict between increasing demand for water and limited water resources. IWRM is a promising mechanism to better use and share water resources. In this article China is an example of implementing IWRM. The characteristics, current situation and problems of the IWRM in China are presented.

articleTitle: Study on the application of robust statistical techniques in interlaboratory comparisons for oil emission spectrometers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In order to insure the reliability and the validity of the detection capability and detection data, 10 oil emission spectrometry laboratories which distribute in different areas tested 3 lubricating oil samples composed by different elements content, and interlaboratory comparisons for the detection capability of oil emission spectrometers were carried out. Based on robust statistical techniques, the detection data was evaluated and the evaluation results of robust Z-score were compared with the results of En. The results shows that the robust Z-score method had 86.67% hit rate, 7.33% failed rate, 6.00% omitted rate; while the En method had 31.33% hit rate, 66.67% failed rate, 2.00% omitted rate. the robust Z-score method is more suitable to be applied to interlaboratory comparisons for oil emission spectrometers than En method.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a simple data query system based on PHP + TXT database
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Starting from practical application,this paper designs a simple data query system, which uses PHP + TXT database technology under Web server environment based on Unix system. The system can be applied to various types of data in WEB real-time online inquiry, and it has extensive application value.

articleTitle: A social network analysis of international trade of copper ore
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper uses data of international trade of copper ore in 2009, which cover 64 countries and 202 trade relationships, to evaluate the bargaining power of exporting and importing countries from the perspective of social network. The countries' bargaining positions in the copper ore trade network and their bargaining power are examined through analysis of their Freeman degree centralities and Bonacich power. The results of these analyses identify prominent exporters and importers with great bargaining power, although they may not be the largest exporters or importers in trade volume, and countries with potential to improve their bargaining positions. The comparison of weighted average Bonacich power of importing and exporting sides of copper ore reveals the possible reason why the price of copper ore was relatively stable.

articleTitle: The construction of conceptual model of working capital management based on SCM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With the development of the supply chain management (SCM) theory, more and more enterprises integrated it into their business management practice, and do researches on the supply chain and financial management integration, in order to improve the operation efficiency. Working capital management is an important part of financial management, which has direct effect on the turnover and utilization rate of the capital. This paper, based on SCM, give the full consideration of the factors may affect working capital management in the business processes of supply chain, builds conceptual model of working capital management based on SCM, enhances working capital management with the system point of view, and opens up new ideas of research on working capital management.

articleTitle: Decentralized precise support in wartime
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In modern war the development of computer and network technology accelerated the birth of effective and precise support mode, which based on taking full advantage of information. At present the most researches on precise support analyzed related problems under an ideal situation that network environment is good and information can be fully shared. But in fact information equipments had inherent formidable vulnerability and they might be attacked as emphasis by opponent, which will result in the failure of traditional precise support. Aiming at this condition, this paper proposed a kind of decentralized precise support mode, which used multiple local centers in different area to autonomous support. Under this mode the key information transmission will be prior to consider so that more global support requirement can be meet. This paper discussed the feasibility of this decentralized support, application modes and related strategies. By a simulation example this paper demonstrated that the proposed decentralized support mode had essentiality and feasibility to practice.

articleTitle: A solution for application transplantation from J2ME to Android
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Google's open-source Android mobile platform has been a powerful competitor of mobile operating system and drawn the attention of the leading manufacturers of the industry and became a hot spot of research. As it adopts the virtual machine Dalvik which is different from SUN Java and its Java application developing framework and API are absolutely different from J2EE, a number of mature J2ME applications cannot be applied on Android platform. Thus the general resolution of transplanting J2ME applications onto Android platform not only protects the existing investment but also enriches the applications on Android platform. After analyzing the similarities and differences between Android and J2ME in aspects of virtual machine and UI, this paper discussed the basic approach of transplanting J2ME applications onto Android platform. Due to words limitation, the paper on takes the transplant of J2ME UI child system as example to illustrate an efficient resolution of transplanting J2ME applications.

articleTitle: Using empirical likelihood method to calculate the Sharpe ratio
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Sharpe ratio is a very well known tool for comparing portfolios which defined as the ratio of expected excess return of a portfolio over the standard deviation of the return series. However, neither the expected return nor its standard deviation is observable. They are estimated by the sample average return and sample standard deviation,respectively. This paper uses the empirical likelihood method to calculate the Sharpe ratio that provides investors with a relatively robust method for estimating risk-adjusted performance.

articleTitle: Model and performance analysis of the flexible manufacturing system based on generalized stochastic Petri net
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: To Analysis the performance of flexible manufacturing system, applied modeling and analysis methods of the generalized stochastic Petri net (GSPN) to modeled and quantitative analysis of the produce process, and received every machine's utilization, the average productivity and the average products level of the flexible manufacturing system. This will provide basis to system's performance evaluation.

articleTitle: The operation mode analysis and optimized platform of Pinke website
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In the era of Web2.0, Pinke websites appeared. This paper targets at some Pinke websites in China and tries to address a clear map about how Pinke websites work. We studied operating modes and implementation practice of 57 domestic professional Pinke websites and 17 carpooling websites abroad. By means of survey, interview, literature search, personal-experiencing and comparative-analysing, we figured out three typical operating modes and some common problems they present. Base on this, the article concludes with a detailed optimized platform. Concerning about no professional introductions related by now, it is supposed to make reference for construction, improvement and featured-operation of Pinke websites.

articleTitle: The simulation on the Enterprise knowledge innovation system in Industrial Clusters
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The different degree of mutual trust between Enterprises, condition of public products and the building virtual organization are important elements of optimize innovation environment to enterprise in Industrial Clusters. This article simulates the process of enterprise knowledge innovation system in industrial clusters by means of Cellular Automata model, the results show that: the higher degree of mutual trust between Enterprises within clusters, better condition of public products and building virtual organization are beneficial for knowledge innovation.

articleTitle: Application on entropy fuzzy comprehesive evaluation for risks of project management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The project management is management activities accompanied with demanding and high risks, so it is necessary to evaluate its risks. Currently methods of risk assessment is more, of which the application of fuzzy mathematics method is the most widely, but this method in determining weight of risk factor exists some limitations. The fuzzy evaluation model based on entropy has been built by analyzing the risk factor of project management and the introduction of “ertropy weight” concept in this text, thus it overcomes the fuzzy mathematics method identified limitations of weight, when the model is applied to the process of construction risk assessment, it proves to be effective and practical, and the method provides reference value and actual guidance for project management decision-making.

articleTitle: Research on management capability of higher education teachers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: By analyzing the change of environment of higher education China, the article draw a conclusion that managerial ability of teacher in higher education has become the key factor in the improvement of the quality of higher education. In this article, the author points out that management capability of teacher in higher education is comprised of planning, organizational, communicative, motivational, leadership and control capabilities, and proposes several measures to raise the standard of management capability of teacher in higher education: upgrading of teaching professionals' theoretical and methodological knowledge, the intensification teachers' practical experience in the various sub-capabilities, and the enhancement of competency evaluation systems.

articleTitle: Research on similarity measure among ship maintenance cost cases based on a combined fuzzy clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Similarity measure among ship maintenance cost cases plays an important role in cost forecasting. A combined fuzzy clustering algorithm which integrates fuzzy transitive closure method and fuzzy c-means method is proposed to deal with this problem. In order to improve the performance of the combined algorithm, a weighted cosine distance method is also put forward to establish a more reasonable fuzzy similar matrix. The experiments show that the proposed fuzzy clustering algorithm can greatly improve the quality of case retrieval. The application of the combined algorithm is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Study of engineering insurance market on hydropower project based on the theory of information asymmetries
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: It is the basis that the sound development of hydropower engineering insurance market is for improving hydropower construction. Therefore, it is of great significance to focus on main participants' strategies. In this paper, it is that the information asymmetry of main participants in hydropower engineering insurance market can be described in detail. Furthermore, incomplete information static game model between insurer and insured is established for the origin of this phenomenon. Meanwhile, for avoiding economic loss caused by moral hazard, this paper puts forward some possible solutions in the market.

articleTitle: The study on blast furnace control system based on fieldbus
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: For blast furnace control systems, the traditional control programs are centralized controls based on PLC; there are too many cables, complex circuit, strong interference, hard maintenance, so we present the application of FCS programs. With distributed control system to put the control method on site which can not only save a lot of cables, ensure self-diagnosis capability of node equipment, but also when the control center or bus fails, it can start semi-automatic mode to ensure smooth production. The practice shows that the control system can save costs for enterprises and improve the informatization level of enterprises.

articleTitle: Amplitude linear-adjustable chaotic signal generator with invariant dynamics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: By introducing a global amplitude adjustable parameter to a chaotic system with Jerk equation form, a chaotic signal generator with dynamic amplitude linear-adjustable is proposed and realized in this paper. Theoretical analysis and numerical simulation results show that with the variation of the amplitude adjustable parameter, the dynamic range of the chaotic attractor generated by this generator is changed linearly and has identical dynamics, i.e., invariant Lyapunov exponent spectrum. An experimental chaotic signal generator is designed. The experimental results well verify the analysis and numerical simulation results.

articleTitle: Application of machine micro-vision in testing in-plane motions for MEMS micro-structures
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Testing of micro-electro-mechanical systems (MEMS) micro-structures motions is important for design and optimization of MEMS devices. A measurement system for in-plane motions was developed with machine micro-vision technology. It can acquire vision images at different phase in the moving periods of MEMS micro-structures. A modified fast sub-pixel matching method was proposed. The vision images were denoised with SUSAN filter algorithm, and then a pixel matching point could be found quickly by means of sequence similadty detection algorithm (SSDA) and standardization covariance correlation algorithm, finally, a sub-pixel matching point could be gotten with correlation function surface-fitting algorithm. The in-plane motions displacement and track can be computed by applying the modified sub-pixel matching method from the vision images. The experimental work conducted on micro-resonator arrays confirms that the measurement system and the new matching method are effective and efficient to test in-plane motions of MEMS micro-structures, and the error of measurement repeatability of amplitude is less than 20 nm.

articleTitle: A novel model of endogenous economic growth
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The relationship between economic growth and bureaucratic corruption, judicial corruption and institutional quality were studied in this paper. Based on the model of endogenous economic growth which was proposed by Erlich and Liu, a theoretical model of economic growth which is involved with the effect from bureaucratic corruption and judicial corruption is presented. The research shows that a country which can resist the judicial corruption and improve institutional quality will promote economic development.

articleTitle: Research on computer immune system based on intrusion tolerance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: When the body is intruded, there is a congenital immune process to find and reduce the damage as quickly as possible. This is an important recovery character for the biology immune system. A model that simulates the biology's congenital immunity is introduced in the computer immune system. It has two basal agents, Damage Detector Agent and Congenital Response Agent. Damage Detector Agent finds intrusion and releases dangerous signal to excited Congenital Response Agent. And it uses a Dynamic Semi-Active Replication technology to ensure the system can work. All this work can improve the system's robustness that it can supply the basic services when it's intruded.

articleTitle: Employers' comment on competence of trade professional: Implications for college education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This research aims to reform mode of college education by exploring employers' comment on competence of trade professional. Face-to-face interviews using self-designed questionnaire were conducted in Zhejiang province. The results reveal that in the view of employers trade professional should be provided with eight categories of competence, i.e. basic commercial skill, personal ability, expression ability, market investigation skill, academic ability, bargaining ability, agency tackling ability, and contract implementing ability, implying that general commercial ability is more important than professional ability. It could be concluded that education mode focused on training of professional skills contributes little to the satisfaction of employers of trade professional. Current education mode of trade professional should be amended according to the market demand.

articleTitle: Study on ERP implementation and business process reengineering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Business processing needs to be recomposed and rebuilt in order to develop the advantages of ERP. ERP successful implementation depends on BPR. They are conditions, complement each other and they serve enterprise overall strategic objectives together. Starting from the overall efficiency of supply chain, choose the department or business which can easily get periodic income to reengineer, or choose a key process which have important influence of the strategic goal as the object of restructuring, to restructure and optimize for the existing business processes.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the combinatorial innovation of word-of-mouth spreading marketing based on the perspective of green marketing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Relationships between human resource dimensions and time-based manufacturing: Proposal of a model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: As companies begin to compete in the challenging business environment, case and industry studies have increased our understanding of time-based competition and focused our attention on its key technical practices, such as time-based manufacturing. While the specialized literature concerning the technical aspects of time-based manufacturing expands, there is a gap in the literature: integrated approaches between human resource dimensions and time-based manufacturing practices. This paper deals with the main contributions of human resource dimensions for the time-based manufacturing in firms. Based on the literature review, this paper discusses the contributions of human resource dimensions to the effectiveness of the time-based manufacturing. A model that analyses the relationships between these dimensions and time-based manufacturing in presented, within a perspective of application for academicians and managers.

articleTitle: The existence of classical solution for the Fokker-Planck-Boltzmann equation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: We will study the non-stationary state homogeneous Fokker-Planck-Boltzmann equation ∂ƒ over ∂t − νΔ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ξ</inf>ƒ=Q(ƒ, ƒ)(ξ,t) in this article. Furthermore we have mass, momentum conservation and energy linear relation identity.

articleTitle: An empirical study of the relationship between science and technology award and the paper output—Take the paper output in a college as a research sample
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Science and technology award is an important measure adopted by colleges and universities in order to increase their science and technology strength. Compared with two groups' relative data under different award, the paper tested the significance of means difference, so as to verify the relationship between the level of science technology award and the paper output. Data analysis indicates that relying solely on the effect of science and technology award as a stimulating factor is hard to raise the research level of a unit or increase the high-level paper output abilities. Other methods should be combined, such as recruiting and training professionals, setting research tasks requirement and optimizing incentives.

articleTitle: Scalable video transcoding method for H.264 over wireless network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Wireless networks have been rapidly developing in recent years. The main objective of this paper is to propose a video transcoding scheme to provide the scalable video data over wireless transmission applications. Moreover video transcoding methods are required for high speed. So we used the pixel-domain close-loop video transcoding construction with reusing decoding information to output H.264 SVC bitstream. Finally, experimental results demonstrated the proposed scheme can reduce the computation of the transcoding process and maintain the output video quality. Our transcoder represents a practical solution which enables rich media communication in heterogeneous mobile environments.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of MEMS sensor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In order to measure the ultra small pressure, a two-island beam membrane structure which has the ability of anti-overload and a high sensitivity is designed in this paper. Theoretical analysis is carried out; it is found that the stress in the edge is maximum. The finite element analysis is carried out by means of ANSYS. The results show that the extreme stress exists in the grooves of the center and edge. Resistors are placed on the grooves to compose a full bridge, which can make the voltage output of the circuit reach the maximum. The sensitivity can reach the maximum.

articleTitle: Simulated maximum likelihood estimation of spatial stochastic frontier model and its application?
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper considers a spatial stochastic frontier model that accounts for possible unknown geographical variation of the outputs. The stochastic frontier model is augmented with a spatial autoregressive structure for the two-sided part of the disturbance, and the time-varying technical inefficiency is not imposed a rigorous function structure. Because of the spatial effect and the asymmetry composed error structure, it is intractable to employ maximum likelihood method directly to estimate the proposed model. Simulated maximum likelihood estimation is used instead. We derive the simulated likelihood function of the model, and present an application of the estimation method on China province-level panel data from 2000 to 2007. The results show that the spatial effect is highly significant, and the ignorance of the spatial effect produces significantly different rankings of technical efficiencies across production units.

articleTitle: Under the market based on incomplete information search theory study of drug price
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper made exploring the root causes of china's virtual-high medicine price as a starting point, and the retail market price of new exclusive production drugs as the research object. Based on the search theory in information economics, through establishing the search model of drug price, this paper derived that the new drug prices mainly affected by search cost demand and the offer distribution. Finally, based on the conclusions, this paper presents the corresponding countermeasures and suggestions.

articleTitle: Research on forestry ecological construction and sustainable development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: To speed up the forestry ecological building is the strategic choice of the economy and society sustainable development and the key of the harmonious development between person and nature. However nowadays China still faces many problems in ecological construction that are seriously hindering the sustainable development of forestry. This article utilizes the combination method of theory and reality, on the foundation of analyzing our forestry ecological building present situation, develops the special study and research to the problem in forestry ecological building and the sustainable development. We propose to carry out the scientific development concept comprehensively and deepen reform innovation mechanism, to speed up the advancement of forestry financing multiplication channel, to encourage and attract companies, individuals and social groups to invest in forestry, to promote the support ability of the technology to the sustainable development of forestry, to strengthen all the people's ecology consciousness to realize the economy and society sustainable development.

articleTitle: A new KDD method based on hypergraph clustering model for farmland evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: There are some shortages in usual methods for land evaluation that too many manual interferences into the calculating procession. A hypergraph clustering model is designed with the knowledge discovery method in this paper based on fuzzy frequent itemsets to conduct the evaluation for quality of farmland. It executes the mining association rules to the fuzzy itemsets given by the definition of evaluation factors, and analyzes the clusters with the HMETIS segmentation method, finally devises the transactions similarity function to cluster the services. In the result, this method could not only determine the quality rating of each units of farmland, but also give the quality description for each grade. With the following example in Guangdong Province, China, the result is testified.

articleTitle: Bank-to-turn missile control system design based on improved fuzzy basis function networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to present systematic procedure for synthesis of nonlinear controllers for complicate nonlinear systems. The approach utilizes an improved fuzzy basis function network (FBFN) to approximate the unknown nonlinear functions of unmolded dynamics, with adaptive laws to be applied to attenuate the effects of approximation errors and external disturbances. Based on the Lyapunov stability theory, the global stability analysis showed that the states and tracking errors of the system are uniformly bounded. Numerical results show that the new controllers achieve excellent tracking performance and exhibit insensitivity to parameter variations over a wide flight envelope.

articleTitle: Security and precaution on computer network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The development of computer network has accelerated the social information, meanwhile lots of network security issues appeared. Therefore, it seems that much more effort should be made to enhance security and precaution on computer network when conducting network application. This essay mainly introduces features of computer network security and primary threats faced by computer network. Finally, it points out relevant measures for computer network security and precaution.

articleTitle: Network user dial-up behavior analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With the development of the Internet and network services, broadband user behavior tends to diversify. It is a rising challenge for the network operators to understand network user behavior. In this paper, we use the Postgres to sort the data records which are caught and extracted from the network monitoring equipment. Then we analyze the characteristics of the data by SPSS, such as login time, logout time, on-line duration and log times and the relationships among them. We extract the main feature, and then use the K-MEAN algorithm to classify the users and carry on the corresponding description. Our results provide a basis for network operators to understand dial-up user behavior, optimize network planning and adjust customer.

articleTitle: How does private enterprises establish the internal control financial system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In order to enhance the level of risk prevention in private enterprises,the concepts should be updated in time by private enterprise management. What should be set in the enterprise are a strong independent control financial institution and a set of simple applicable internal financial evaluation index system as well as a high quality of internal financial personnel. Moreover, the functions of the internal control of financial system should be expanded continuously in practice. Thus a function from simple to complex, from local internal to the comprehensive control of private enterprise internal control will be established.

articleTitle: Bibliometric analysis of the domestic clustering algorithm research
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: By using all the research papers related to the clustering algorithms which were collected by the China Journal Full-text Database (CJFD) during 2002 - 2009, this paper has studied the present status and trend of the clustering algorithm research in China from the points of the papers' quantity, periodicals, authors and subject by means of bibliometric analysis. The number of the papers shows the increase trend, though there is lack of innovation and empirical research in the content and research leaders; The stream data clustering, outlier analysis and user behavior analysis have been focus in this field. However, there is not enough empirical research. Facing the exist various problems in this field, the domestic researchers should track the foreign study to make it combined with practice, then produce the economy benefit and promote the domestic clustering algorithm research to be more forward and practical.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Microstructure evolution of Ag/SnO2 Electrical Contact Materials via severe plastic deformation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on vehicle routing problem with soft time windows and distribution time constraints of vehicles
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: We set up a mathematical model of problem on the basis of distribution time constraints of vehicles in vehicle routing optimization. In order to solve this problem, a hybrid algorithm was designed based on the integration of genetic algorithm and ant colony optimization algorithm, which improves search efficiency of algorithm. Transition rule of operation part of ant colony optimization was modified in hybrid algorithm based on the characteristics of the problem so that feasibility of algorithm is improved. Simulation result shows that it can apply to the practical application and can achieve good optimization results.

articleTitle: The design criticism and management in product Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: To improve the quality of product Innovation and new product development, the paper discusses how to play the role of design criticism in product innovation, analyses the relationship between design criticism and product innovation, believes design criticism and management is not only an important part of product innovation, but an essential content of future management innovation, and raises the way of strengthening it, hence enriches the management theory of product innovation.

articleTitle: Protection and development of famous historical and cultural cities based on sustainable development—A case study of Nanjing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The development of cities is an eternal topic. However, we should pay more attention to the protection of the history and culture in the development of famous historical and cultural cities. There are several universal problems during the development and protection process of such cities. To develop historical and cultural cities based on the principle of sustainable development is the key idea and most important among the diversified solutions. This paper analyses the problems during the development process of famous historical and cultural cities, comes up with several strategies of sustainable development from three different aspects including government, enterprises and society, and then takes City Nanjing as an example to clarify.

articleTitle: The global existence for diffusion equations with small delay
