articleTitle: The trend of changes in Chinese consumption behavior after the financial crisis: Positive research based on sequential decision
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: According to this article, macroscopic changes in the increasing speed of Chinese consumption indicates that, with the comprehensive influences of the financial crisis and macroscopic control lance, an unexpected change must have taken place in individual consumption behaviour, too. Authors of this article planned to collect microcosmic statistics in respect of individual consumption behavior by means of questionnaires. Then the statistics will be quantization. The Mapco Model of the sequential decision will be used to demonstrate the overall directions of changes in Chinese people's consumption ability. It is found that in the process of China's internationalization, the state policy of macroscopic control lance will do its utmost to reduce and release the evil effects on the Chinese economy by the deteriorating international economic environment. Macroscopic control lance, by making use of the international economic power, permeates itself into individual consumption behavior and at the same time promotes consumption activeness. The colonization effect, resulting from changes in individual consumption behavior, would promote the development of the macroscopic economy towards a better future.

articleTitle: The research of China industrial electricity consumption based on LMDI
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Based on economic background, the paper introduces a relatively reasonable decomposition method - logarithmic mean Divisia index (LMDI), and decomposes the electricity consumption of industry from 1994 to 2006 into three parts: production effect, structure effect, intensity effect with the LMDI method in order to find out the effect to the electricity consumption. According to the calculation based on the production value without the effect of price and the electricity consumption of industry sub-sectors, the paper finds that the increase in electricity efficiency within industry is more important, and furthermore the paper proposes the government to establish the system of energy decomposition indices as the basis for policy making especially the power policy making, and adjust the structure in the direction of saving the electricity.

articleTitle: Research on design of E-government business framework at the department of Fujian Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of informatization for government departments, Effective integration becomes urgent for business application systems. To achieve this goal, we must comprehensively sort out and analyze all the business of government departments, and establish corresponding business framework in order to provide a constructing basis for developing the business system. The paper will design a general business framework based on provincial department, and present the design process in detail.

articleTitle: Reach on the relationship between logistics industry and regional economy increase
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The importance of the logistics industry to the regional economy development is analyzed, and the systems dynamics model has been used to analyze the relationship between logistics industry and the region economy in qualitative aspects. Take Zhengzhou as the example, analyze the contribution of the logistics industry auctioning to the regional economy by statistics, the practicability of the model and the instructional of the theory were proved.

articleTitle: Research on the management innovation of student affairs based on the social work theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: It is uneven on the level of operation and development in management mechanism of Chinese college student affairs. Through the elaboration of the ways on social work, and based on the social theory, we do some research on the management innovation of student, methods of setting goal, establishing ideal and achieving, which can consummate the management mechanism, enhance and improve the work experience. All of these, it can advance the development of student both body and mind.

articleTitle: Construction of performance audit and evaluation indicator system of financial support for agriculture
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The paper takes as its objective construction of performance evaluation indicator system of financial support for agriculture. It employs modern management method, poses four principles and designs a complete 5 E indicator system including 28 indicators. Based on these indicators, it has field researches on performance audit in 4 counties and regions in Zhejiang Province, leading to conclusions with strong realistic significance.

Author Keywords: performance auditing of fiscal fund expenditure for assisting agriculture

articleTitle: Value innovation of mobile communication industry in China rural area:A case study on “Tianfu Agriculture Information Network”
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With the application of theoretical analysis, questionnaire, statistical analysis and case study, this research proposes the strategic basis of the development of rural mobile communication market from the viewpoint of demand and supply based on the latent information demand of rural consumers and the cost - benefit characteristics of mobile communication in rural area. Then the author applies the value innovation model to design the strategic framework from the microscopic aspect. Combined with the practice of construction of information system in rural area illustrated by the case of “Tianfu Agriculture Information Network”, the author develops the discussion on strategy implementation and works out a strategic system of sustainable development in rural mobile communication market in an innovative way. It is a successful business model when developing the mobile communication service in a market especially which are short of consumption capacity.

articleTitle: The measure of agricultural informatization level and the contribution of it to agricultural economic growth-based on the statistics of HUNAN province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Mainly according to the method of Marc Porat, based on the data of HUNAN province from 2003 to 2008,this paper calculates the Level of agricultural informatization, and empirical analyses the contribution of agricultural informatization to economic growth by using the amended C-D production function and the method of lagged variable and comes to the following conclusion: the level of agricultural informatization of HUNAN province was still at the initial stage, but the agricultural informatization has become the third source of agricultural economic growth in Hunan province, its contribution is only next to the agricultural labor and agricultural capital factor.

articleTitle: Effectiveness evaluation of aviation material support based on synthesis set pair analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Research on effectiveness evaluation method of aviation material support has important practical significance for the operational capability of aviation weapon equipment established and maintained. This paper aim at uncertain factors and dynamic characteristics of evaluation process, put forward the synthesis evaluation method of aviation material support based on Set Pair Analysis (SPA) and Markov chain, and provide scientific basis for strategy of aviation material support by decision-makers constituted.

articleTitle: Mechanics analysis and design of pressure sensor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Based on the classical plate theory and elasticity theory, this paper analyzes and discusses sensor chip with all round fixed. It is studied on the behaviors of stress on the diaphragm of semiconductor piezoresistive pressure sensor. This provides a basis theory for designing sensor. We explore the value and width of resistors and give a particular description of the serial calculation. Based on the theory, by the use of finite-element method (FEM) software of ANSYS, then the simulation results are compared and analyzed for strain diaphragm of silicon piezoresistive pressure sensor. This paper investigates the linearity and dynamic frequency response of the sensor and obtains the reliable results.

articleTitle: The design of oil content tester based on pulsed nuclear magnetic resonance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: A new-type crop seed oil content tester is introduced, this instrument is based on pulsed nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) theory, and is applied the method of spin echo signal to achieve high-precision measurement of seed oil content. It has advantages such as safe, pollution free, fast, easy to handle, does not destroy the sample, etc. It can be used for occasions like keeping rare and precious seeds and quickly determine the oil contents. As relatively stronger resonance signal can be got via the pulse NMR method, the measurement accuracy of this analytical instrument is higher than prescribed ISO 10565 standard, surpassing other testing methods.

articleTitle: Study on application of value engineering in selection and improvement of hydrate-preventing technology projects in gas field?
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: VE aims to find solutions to reduce the cost based on the clients' needs of function, which fits the demand of economic and efficient exploitation. Based on discussion of the possibility and necessity of application of Value Engineering in selection and improvement of technology projects for enterprises, this article made theoretical analysis on the application methods, then took an example of hydrate-preventing technology projects in gas field to further study on the application of VE. The article reached the conclusion that analysis on the overall value options in a technology project would help enterprises in decision making in technology selection, and by further analysis on matching degree of the function and cost in the function blocks, the function blocks which need improvement could be identified.

articleTitle: Modified Adaptive Genetic Algorithm for Flexible Job-shop Scheduling Problem
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we present a Modified Adaptive Genetic Algorithm (MAGA) for Flexible Job-Scheduling Problem (FJSP), a simulation model is presented to solve the FJSP. The proposed model has been coded by Matlab which is a special mathematical computation language. After modeling the pending problem, the model is validated by a representative instances based on practical data. The result obtained from the computational study has shown that the proposed approach is a feasible and effective approach for the FJSP.

articleTitle: Study on model building of emergency logistics management information system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Based on the functions of the information technology in the building of emergency logistics system and using the operation features of disaster relief emergency logistics system of other countries for reference, this paper has proposed the building model of emergency logistics information system and its basic constitutions. In addition, it has also discussed the building models and the function patterns of various subsystems and put forward the proposal to improve the operation mechanism of the emergency logistics management system.

articleTitle: The researches on some questions about the industrial cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Industrial cluster is the very important method for the area and even the country to improve its international competitive strength and get the advantage position in the market. After Marshall offered the theory of industrial cluster, many countries adjusted their industry planning and tried to develop the external economy advantage and achieved the better achievements, example the auto car industrial cluster in Detroit, the Silicon Valley in California and the smallware industrial cluster in YiWu, ZheJiang province etc. The author discussed the various types of the industrial cluster and offered some questions for the governments and enterprises should pay more attention when they want to make the industrial cluster policies or take the industrial cluster in this paper,especially offered some suggestions for the domestic companies how to use the advantage of the industrial cluster to improve their international competitiveness under the circumstance that the multinational companies occupy the leading role in the industrial cluster areas and the result is that the better long-term strategy is the foundation for the governments and companies and the independent innovation is the only way for the companies to get the leading role in this field.

articleTitle: Research of quality evaluation of Mechanical Design, Manufacturing and Automation graduates based on the AHP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: There is lack of a scientific evaluating system about quality evaluation of Mechanical Design, Manufacturing and Automation graduates currently. In order to evaluate the quality of the graduates correctly, according to the talents training objective and characteristics of the subject, an index system for the quality evaluation of Mechanical Design, Manufacturing and Automation graduates was established according to the Experts' Consult Delphi in this study. The weighting coefficient of each index was decided by means of Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). This job provides not only the reference for employers to employ graduates, but also the foundation for colleges to complete the training pattern of talents.

articleTitle: The international propagation of shocks in international equity markets during the subprime mortgage crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: We focus on the contagion effects of international financial markets arising from financial crisis. By analyzing a panel of percentage natural logarithm return rate of 12 countries, we qualify the impact of financial contagion in global equity markets from the subprime mortgage crisis. The paper uses adjusted correlation analysis approach and latent factor model to measure the international propagation of common and idiosyncratic shocks respectively. The results show that as the United States is the centre of the subprime mortgage crisis, contagion decreases with the geographical distance from the centre, closer the distance, greater the effect will be, that is, America is the most affected area, followed by Europe, then the Asia region. To put it further, through variance decomposition we compare countries in America and Asia to see the effects and degree of contagion. We find that China and Japan are the least affected countries compared with others and we explain the reason at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Knowledge discovery method based on data mining for marine propulsion system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Modern vessels have comprehensive platform management capability that allow them to achieve unprecedented levels of operational effectiveness and contribute to crew reduction. The focus of this paper is to address a new knowledge discovery method based on data mining to support the task activities for integrated management of ship propulsion system. The requirements of management knowledge are analyzed. Data mining algorithm is put forward to identify the related useful running mode knowledge of marine propulsion system. This new method which based on data mining would enhance the capability of knowledge based management for marine propulsion system.

articleTitle: Study on knowledge discovery algorithms based on the bit granular matrix
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Based on the definition of bit granular matrix, a matrix-based knowledge discovery algorithm is proposed and it can attribute reduction and attribute value reduction simplifies the mathematical operations directly, In the operation process, Reflect the extent of the knowledge understanding, provided a new research approach to study on knowledge representation, decomposition, synthesis, reduction, etc.

articleTitle: Study of competitiveness improvement strategies for Chinese construction industry based on Diamond Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: In view of the status quo that the whole construction industries are lack of competitiveness in china, combined with the characteristics of construction industry, this paper systematically analyzed the key factors that influence the competitiveness of construction industry by deductive methods and relying on Professor Porter's Diamond Model. Based on this, we analyzed the current problems that existed in the development process of domestic construction industry by applying the idea of systematic analysis. Finally, we put forward corresponding strategies against the existing issues from nation, region and enterprise level respectively.

articleTitle: Efficient block type decision algorithm for H.264/AVC intra-prediction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The latest video coding standard H.264/AVC significantly increases video compression efficiency but also incurs high computation complexity. In order to reducing the rate-distortion optimization computational cost, a model fitting based block edge pattern detection method is used to conduct the block type decision in H.264/AVC intra-prediction. Experiments show that it can save 42.92% coding time for all intra frame sequence with PSNR loss less than 0.09db and bits increase less than 2.46% on average when comparing with the reference software JM8.6.

articleTitle: Frame length adjustment method research of dynamic framed slotted ALOHA algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Multi-tag RFID systems for the collision problem, analyzed the dynamic frame slotted ALOHA algorithm, the algorithm is a key part of the frame length adjustment. The mathematical theory of combining frame length, obtained three ways. Validated by simulation analysis estimated that the number of improved labeling method can reflect the dynamic real-time collision case the current frame, the system identification efficiency has improved significantly.

articleTitle: The development status and path of Guangdong science and technology services industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: There are two problems cried to be concerned about of Guangdong science and technology services industry: unbalanced development of science and technology services industry in different regions of Guangdong; unreasonable structure of various science and technology services institutions. To establish development path so as to improve the level of science and technology services, and form a complete and effective science and technology services industry chain, we provide implementation path and strategy by considering organizations, infrastructures and common technologies adapting to the development path.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation research of the stall flow field of the transonic compressor blade tip
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The rotating stall of turbo machinery causes the bottleneck in the air compressor performance further improving. Based on the numerical simulation research of the transonic compressor rotor, the flow field details which cannot get from experiments were derived, and the physical mechanism of the first stall at blade tip in transonic compressor was qualitatively interpreted, then it was found that the spatial trajectory of leakage vortex center at the blade tip is almost the same in different conditions. Because of the shock wave of the blade flow field gradually moves to the upstream and intensity increases with the decrease of the flow rate. While the leakage flows of the blade tip were increasing, the rupture of the blade tip leakage vortex was getting more serious. Thus blade row channels of the rotor blade tip are jammed, which is the main reason of blade tip stall. Blade load is beyond the load capacity because of the increase of the attack angle of the rotor blade tip under the near stall condition, which is another reason of blade tip stall. These conclusions provide the useful information to reveal compressor internal stall mechanism.

articleTitle: An embedded design of intelligent artificial anus
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Rectal cancer is one of common multiple gastrointestinal cancer. So far, implanting the permanent artificial anus after rectal cancer radical correction is an effective treatment. Since the anus can not control defecation and exhausting, the patients have different degrees of mental burden. Therefore, this article introduces a new type of intelligent artificial anus. This artificial anus is based on AT89C52 microcontroller control. It uses pressure sensors to detect whether there is excretion in the intestine. If there is excretion, AT89C52 will open ultrasonic sensor to detect and determine the nature of excretion and provide different warning information to the patient. The patient will decide whether to open the intestinal switch to defecate or exhaust according to these warning information. This new type of artificial annus solves the patients' inconvenience to some extent in defecation and exhausting which are beyond the control.

articleTitle: Based on the owner of the construction project management research
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Construction project management involves multiple parties, the owners management of construction project plays a fundamental and core role in project management. Combining theory and practice, based on the owner's view of building project management, the paper explained a number of points in order to better implement the project management, so as to better promote Chinese construction market and industry healthy and stable development.

articleTitle: Driver traffic safety behavior of the interval fuzzy evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper discusses the definition of interval number and basic algorithm. It also described the problem of interval ranking and introduced interval-valued fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model. The model is more suitable for evaluation of many factors, weight distribution than the uniform case. Interval-valued fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model to judge the field of driver traffic safety behavior. According to literature reviews to establish the evaluation index system and set. Then determine the weight of different factors and required basic data by the expert scoring. Finally, the results of the evaluation model is excellent. The application examples explain that the method can effectively reduce the loss of information which with good results.

articleTitle: Construction concurrent engineering partner selection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Construction concurrent engineering (CE) partner selection has important significance for CE in the construction industry. This paper developed a CE partner selection model for construction industry, which includes three processes. First was determined partner selection index system, second was application of the house of quality (HOQ) to determine weights of system. The third was combine fuzzy multifactorial evaluation and AHP to construction partner selected. Thesis work provided a new way for the construction of concurrent engineering partner selection.

articleTitle: Constraint solving based on a simplified method of cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The traditional geometric constraint problems are focus on two dimensions, but in this paper, we do our research on three-dimensional geometric elements. Firstly, we translate geometric constraint problem into the form of analytic geometry, and then apply these basic knowledge to geometric assembly. We also introduce the definition of cluster in order to translate the geometric constraint problem into it. After simplified clusters, we can determine the location and coordinates of them according to the knowledge of corresponding analytic geometry, and finally determine the location of geometric elements.

articleTitle: Agent programming language and its complier implementation based on JavaCC
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper aims to present an agent-oriented programming language-IAPL based on BDI structure, and implement a compiler according to the IAPL's operational semantics by JavaCC.

articleTitle: International comparative study to government regulation about Cross-border Mergers and Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Since 1990s, under trend of the economic globalization and integration of regional economics, the trans-corporation is in order to pursue global management strategy, strengthen its competition advantage and strategic position in the international market, have raised a large-scale, far-reaching Mergers and Acquisition (M&A) tide in the world, cross-border M&A becomes the main form of trans-corporation's foreign direct investment. However, Cross-border M&G is challenging the supervision of the government of host country while realizing the economic benefits for the trans-corporation, and form Interactive games in Cross-border M&G investment and the supervision of the government of host country. This text mainly introduces experience in Cross-border M&A Regulation of western developed country such as U.S.A., through comparing its similarities and differences, received some beneficial experience. The purpose is for impelling Chinese Government to seek a kind of regulation system, which can protect normal Cross-border M&A, safeguard the vigor of the market competition, and can prevent the forming of market monopolization effectively. While utilizing the foreign capitals, guarantee economy and even country's security.

articleTitle: Study on detailed stresses of crossbeam web cutout for steel orthotropic deck
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Finite element analyses were carried out to probe into the stress characteristics of crossbeam web cutout for steel orthotropic deck. Considering the load distribution of wearing surface, stress characteristics were researched for the central crossbeam web cutout in the case of fixed wheel loads with totally symmetrical distribution. The results show that the maximum principal stress distributes primarily in region near the start point of crossbeam cutout. Keeping the longitudinal symmetric of wheel loads with respect to the central crossbeam, after altering loads transverse location, influence was investigated on the in-plane stresses of cutout. It is pointed out that stress distributes in the start point of crossbeam cutout is sensitive for the non-fixing transverse locations of wheel loads. In addition, keeping the transverse symmetric of wheel loads with respect to the central longitudinal rib, the influence on the out-plane stresses of cutout was evaluated by altering the longitudinal location of wheel load. A fact is disclosed that different longitudinal location of wheel loads is one of the important factors to determine the stress distributes in the start point of crossbeam cutout. What's more, stress of cutout was further discussed without load distribution of wearing surface. The transverse stress of the start point of crossbeam cutout is impacted significantly of the area distributed over by the wheel loads. Influencing factors of the stress distributes in the start point of crossbeam cutout are so multiple and complex that this part of steel orthotropic deck should be the emphatic work in the design and fabrication.

articleTitle: Research on risk assessment of dam removal
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper identifies the risks of removing dams and sorts the risks into five categories, namely, life risk, economic risk, technological risk, environmental risk and social risk. On this basis, this paper builds a risk index system of removing dams. By using TOPSIS-AHP model, the paper constructs a risk assessment model of dam removal.

articleTitle: A study of the efficiency of Chinese medicine listed companies based on DEA and RST
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Investors of listed Chinese medicine companies is the community. How to correctly use the information to evaluate the Chinese medicine listed companies' performance scientifically and provide reference information for all stakeholders and corporate managers, is a problem that become more and more urgent and important in theory and reality. This paper firstly sets up an input-output mode to appraise the relative effectiveness of Chinese medicine listed companies by DEA method, and implements the discretization process to make the model results discrete. Secondly, we make use of rough set to give synthesizing evaluation score to every object through the dispersed data. The integrated use of DEA and RST can fully reflect the input-output character of operational efficiency and through the established model we can get a more reasonable result without artificial influence.

articleTitle: Research of MEMS piezoresistive pressure sensor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: A series of theoretical analysis about double island-beam structure sensor is discussed in this paper. The position for sitting resistances on the diaphragm, the resistance values and the width of the resistances are analyzed in detail. Utilizing finite-element method (FEM) and simulation software ANSYS, static and dynamics analysis and computer simulation are carried out for strain diaphragm of piezoresistive micro-pressure sensor. Analysis of simulation by ANSYS reveals that the structure sensor structure which we adopted in this paper has a high sensitivity, good linearity, and high anti-overload and so on.

articleTitle: Research on the applied talents training based on technical education base
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the applied talents training, we carried out some related theoretical study and practical exploration on innovative course structure, innovation resource strategy, innovative curriculum model and other aspects, and got some useful thought and experience. A creative talents training mode was created based on technology education base. Some reference and guidance significance for talents training were provided in this paper.

articleTitle: Wireless data transmission system based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: A wireless data transmission system based on TMS320DM642 is introduced. nRF24L01 is used as wireless rf chip. The interface circuit and software design are explained, some important programs are given.. The system can complete processing and wireless transmission of digital signal without other microcontrollers. It can be used to complete communication of static image or voice signal.

articleTitle: A fuzzy neural network model with application to Financial Risk Early Warning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The traditional financial risk warning model are all based on probability theory and statistical analysis, but the precisions of the results are usually not satisfied in practice. In this study, rough set theory is first used to evaluate factors and then the key factors are selected as inputs to construct a neural network model combined with fuzzy rules. Furthermore, the fuzzy neural network (FNN) model is applied to Financial Risk Early Warning(FREW) problem. The results indicate that the predictive accuracies obtained from FNN are much higher than the ones obtained from NN system. To make this clearer, an illustrative example is given for demonstration..

articleTitle: Flexible job-shop scheduling study based on multi-swarm hybrid particle swarm arithmetic
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Due to the complex computation and restrictive condition in flexible job-shop scheduling problem, common arithmetic can not get best solution. The article makes use of multi-swarm hybrid particle swarm arithmetic to solve the problem. Through multi-swarm evolution simultaneity and best solution concentration, the arithmetic's efficiency is increased to get better flexible job-shop scheduling. The emulation experiment shows that the arithmetic can solve flexible job-shop scheduling problem effectively.

articleTitle: Knowledge-enabled human resource development research based on case heterogeneity
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The knowledge-enabled human resource development is to excavate human resources potentiality by the method and tool of information management, and create the capital value of intelligence through the optimization of the procedure of human resources development. This text probes into the heterogeneity identity characteristic directed against the staff, and heterogeneity human resources knowledge, train partiality, train history, position qualification standard, etc., produce the procedure according to the heterogeneity KHRD solution, provide the knowledge deviation of ability, training scheme, career and develop the scheme, management and develop heterogeneity KHRD solutions such as the scheme, etc., and expresses the method and embodiment application to put forward the concrete case.

articleTitle: Effect of 1-methylcyclopropene on bioavailability of in vitro digests from ‘ Fuji ’ apple
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The aim of this work was to examine the effect of 1-methylcyclopropene (1-MCP) on bioavailability of `Fuji' apple (Zizyphus jujuba M.) during the period of shelf life. Fruits were exposed to 0.5 μL<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> of 1-MCP for 24 h at room temperature, following storage, fruits were held up to 8 days and assessed for quality, membrane permeability, malondialdehyde (MDA), and using an in vitro digestion system that simulated the physiochemical changes that occurred in the upper gastrointestinal tract. The differences in fruit firmness, soluble solid concentration (SSC), and membrane permeability with 1-MCP treatment were manifested during shelf life period. MDA, an indicator of lipid peroxidation caused by reactive oxygen species, increased during shelf life and the contents were significantly lower in fruit treated with 1-MCP than control samples. The results indicated 1-MCP was an effective tool for quality improvement and extension of shelf life in apples, and showed that the bioavailability of tissues was tightly related to the quality of fruits and the simulated digestion appeared to be an efficient tool for studying the bioavailability from fruits and vegetables.

articleTitle: Study on the model of collaboration trust in supply chain based on ontology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Collaboration relation among companies in supply chain is facing serious challenges because of partners' opportunism and demoralization. Therefore, collaboration trust in supply chain is viewed as a central problem for discussion. The paper puts forward a framework of collaboration trust in supply chain based on ontology including: Primitive Information Layer, Information filtration Layer, Trust Ontology Layer, Ontology Query Layer and Application and Explanation Layer; and designs the domain ontology in trust and the other four sub-domains: enterprise trust ontology, product trust ontology, service trust ontology and information trust ontology. The three-level model comprehensively analyses the trust in the supply chain from four aspects, providing scientific and rational proposals for the cultivation, development and stability of collaboration trust in supply chain to promote stable development of supply chain relationships.

articleTitle: Objective decision-making of production system with more expected competitive production
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: With the economic globalization and the market competition intensifies, market require the production system increasing by the product. On the basis of clear customer needs and business requirements, it's essential for a production company, which wants to gain a competitive edge and to ensure the effectiveness and sustainability of production systems competitive, to formulate a correct strategy for the production system design and effective production system optimization decision-making. This article collects a series of new requirements which could help the manufacturers to output products to gain competitive advantage in the market, and as an attempt, This article uses a simulation method called triangular fuzzy numbers in the objective decision-making of production system, investigating a problem that the preference information of decision makers is given by the form of preference sequence, and the target weights are completely unknown, and the decision matrix element are the triangular fuzzy numbers. This approach fully into account the risk attitude of decision makers which influences the results, which applies the number of programs and goals for the number are large, decision makers can not give specific preference value of each program's situation.

articleTitle: The application of ISM in the commodity residential investment estimation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The investment estimation of construction project is critical in the stage of feasibility study, the result directly impacts on investment decision-making, Aiming at insufficient scientific defects of the artificial neural network which is applied in selecting input vector, ISM (Interpretative Structural Model) would be applied to analysis the factor affecting commercial house cost, the levels of the influencing factors would be divided by the influencing grade to the cost of commercial houses so as to select a greater impact factors on the cost as the input vector, and make the application of artificial neural network in the investment estimates are more reliability.

articleTitle: Study of the effective resource allocation of university logistics based on grade payoff
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Before the socializing reform of university logistics, it was mainly self-employed and non-profit oriented, which caused more managing costs and serious waste of resources. After the implementation of the socializing reform, many universities cannot control the scale of the reform. As a result, the side effect of marketing evidently shows up. Some operators of the logistic service project put profit in the first place, leading to the price increase of most public service, but bad service quality, influencing the normal life and study of students and faculty members. Essentially, this is a game between the universities and the operators. Based on the mathematical model of grade payoff, with scientific methods, this paper explores the guiding suggestions and strategies of the phenomenon concerned.

articleTitle: An analysis of innovation performance of industrial design and its influential factors—Based on a survey of firms in Ningbo
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Based on a Survey of 190 enterprises in Ningbo City, China, this thesis aims at finding out which is the most inflecting factor for the innovation performance of industrial design. After analyzing the innovation status of industrial design such as the enterprises' willingness on innovation of industrial design, their investment and innovation performance, it gives an practical analyze on innovation performance of industrial design and its influential factors. It shows that human capital is the most influential factor, while capital has weak correlation with innovation performance. At last, this paper provides some suggestions for the enterprises making industrial design innovation.

articleTitle: Study on the quantum leap model of insight knowledge learning and conversion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: This paper confirms that the knowledge management plays an important role in the organization. From the phenomenon of insight, we founded the quantum leap properties of the knowledge learning and conversion. Based on the previous studies, we put forward the quantum leap model of the knowledge, elaborate its content in the microscopic and macroscopical perspective, reveale the Principle of knowledge learning and conversion, and give some advice to the theory study.

articleTitle: The reform of armored equipment maintenance based on lean six sigma
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: Based on lean six sigma (LSS), the reform is carried out in our armored equipment maintenance. The process is divided into five stages: definition, measurement and analysis, improvement, test working and control. In the definition stage, the problems of our armored maintenance, reformed aim and effect, are proposed, respectively. After our army's practice is analyzed deeply by LSS tools, main contents of armed maintenance reform are proposed. Circumstantialities and the effect of the LSS reform in a certain unit are introduced.

articleTitle: On evaluation of social work scheme in S college with CIPP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: CIPP model, including context Evaluation, input evaluation, process evaluation and product evaluation, is an effective evaluation method. Via CIPP, the contribution of the social work scheme to teachers, students and schools in S college can be objectively observed, as well as the direction of improvement for those social workers.

articleTitle: The study on the appraisal of influencing factors of the enterprise technology innovation talents' team
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Future Information Technology and Management Engineering
abstract: The team-building of technology innovation talents is directly related to the survival and development of enterprises.First this paper proposes an index system of appraising an enterprise technology innovation talents'team, and then use ANP(analytic network process) method to analyze the relation between the indexes,and to obtain the weight of each index. This paper reveals the degree of each index's influencing enterprise technology innovation talents' team, and makes enterprises be clear about the key influencing factor, and then strives to offer references for enterprises.
